subject: The GOP is using state resources in Florida to intimidate voters

Friend — I want to be upfront with you regarding something alarming happening right here in Florida.
On Election Day, control of the Senate and who we send to the White House won't be the only things on the ballot. In Florida, we'll vote on an amendment to enshrine the right to abortion into our state constitution — thereby _overturning Rick Scott's extreme abortion ban._
But here's the disturbing part: Right now, state police are showing up to Floridians' homes and interrogating them about their support of a petition that paved the way for this constitutional amendment ballot initiative.
**As a child, I lived under a South American dictatorship with my mother and three older sisters. I remember the strongman tactics of an authoritarian regime — and _Ron DeSantis is replicating those tactics here in Florida._**
It's obvious why they are resorting to authoritarian tactics. DeSantis and my opponent Rick Scott — who supports a nationwide ban on abortions — know voter turnout is going to _skyrocket_ in support of protecting reproductive rights.
These are precisely the voters we need to reach, speak with, and mobilize in support of our campaign because we share their values of freedom, opportunity, and the right to start a family when and how they choose — not when and how politicians like Rick Scott or Ron DeSantis say.
**But to win, to protect reproductive rights and defeat Rick Scott, I must hit my next $150,000 goal before my midnight deadline. That's why I'm counting on you, more than ever, to give now.**

clean_body: | | | Friend — I want to be upfront with you regarding something alarming happening right here in Florida. On Election Day, control of the Senate and who we send to the White House won't be the only things on the ballot. In Florida, we'll vote on an amendment to enshrine the right to abortion into our state constitution — thereby overturning Rick Scott's extreme abortion ban. But here's the disturbing part: Right now, state police are showing up to Floridians' homes and interrogating them about their support of a petition that paved the way for this constitutional amendment ballot initiative. As a child, I lived under a South American dictatorship with my mother and three older sisters. I remember the strongman tactics of an authoritarian regime — and Ron DeSantis is replicating those tactics here in Florida. It's obvious why they are resorting to authoritarian tactics. DeSantis and my opponent Rick Scott — who supports a nationwide ban on abortions — know voter turnout is going to skyrocket in support of protecting reproductive rights. These are precisely the voters we need to reach, speak with, and mobilize in support of our campaign because we share their values of freedom, opportunity, and the right to start a family when and how they choose — not when and how politicians like Rick Scott or Ron DeSantis say. But to win, to protect reproductive rights and defeat Rick Scott, I must hit my next $150,000 goal before my midnight deadline. That's why I'm counting on you, more than ever, to give now. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Debbie | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33644&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmlkZW9zL3JpZ2h0cy1hbmQtZnJlZWRvbXMtaW4tcGVyaWwtZXhjbHVzaXZlLWJvb2stbGF1bmNoLXdpdGgtdG9tLWZpdHRvbi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=73cfd4ec5ce34a7c47278879e7aeed98afff1aa62b78ffcd90698ec657bcd8e7]
My fourth Judicial Watch book, _Rights and Freedoms in Peril_: _An
Investigative Report on the Left's Attack on America_, is set for
publication on October 15. It details a long chain of abuses officials
and political groups have made against the American people and is
available for pre-order now at JudicialWatchBook.com
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=32838&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=ba8bd96ab41142a1841e8c567ecfc4a6ccfc96704092458b4162b48c53db16a5]

My first three books were _New York Times_ bestsellers.

Since the release of the previous book, _A Republic Under Assault_,
the Left has taken extraordinary steps to eradicate American liberty,
motivated by a radical ideology whose adherents occupy the nation’s
highest offices. Now, in _Rights and Freedoms in Peril_: _An
Investigative Report on the Left’s Attack on America _(Threshold
Editions/Gallery Books), I detail a long chain of abuses officials and
politicians have made against the American people and call readers to
battle for the soul and survival of America.

You will be taken to the front lines where the progressive movement
threatens America’s most venerable institutions, undermining the
core principles that make this country a beacon of hope to the world.
The Left has declared war on everything from the rule of law to a
colorblind U.S. Constitution, border security, and government
accountability. Their anti-American agenda must be stopped to save our
country’s future.

My previous book, _A Republic Under Assault, The Left’s Ongoing
Attack on American Freedom_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=32839&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9SZXB1YmxpYy1VbmRlci1Bc3NhdWx0LUFtZXJpY2FuLUp1ZGljaWFsL2RwLzE5ODIxNjM2NTg/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=e5008b7c8226dfc3911c1b52623160b807ca33051fa9d47e31b707d0ec59b06d],
is a hard-hitting, fast-paced look at how the Radical Left and the
Deep State tried to destroy the Trump presidency. It expands on the
observation that “President Biden has a personal corruption problem,
has obvious health challenges, and must manage internal warfare
between his party’s corrupt corporate wing and its rising
Communists. His moral claim on the presidency is rejected by a massive
number of voters.”

The first two bestselling books, _The Corruption Chronicles_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=19602&F=T&&hash=7474200ed42d5aebcb8626f2f89ca9662c4e1ec3bd222af3c87c697f4c3121f4]
and _Clean House_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=19603&F=T&&hash=81607ec061eb7c44d99b045b0e62474398242828bdd836da886061d3340c7a6e]
revealed what Judicial Watch, the world’s largest and most effective
watchdog group, uncovered in its battles against Obama administration
secrecy.

Politicized indictments, ruined elections, invasions, and compromised
politicians have placed our republican form of government in danger.
There is a way forward, but we must be diligent about understanding
the scope and detail of the peril.

Shedding light on the truths and secrets of the left, _Rights and
Freedoms in Peril_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=32838&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=ba8bd96ab41142a1841e8c567ecfc4a6ccfc96704092458b4162b48c53db16a5]
provides that way
forward.

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES AIR FORCE ACADEMY FOR DEI DETAILS

Diversity, equity and inclusion, DEI, seems like Job No. 1 for our
nation’s military academies. The Biden-Harris Defense Department is
obsessed with indoctrinating our rising military leadership with woke,
anti-American ideology. Judicial Watch filed yet another lawsuit to
expose and stop this abuse of the young men and women in the Air Force
Academy.

We filed the lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33633&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3N0YXJycy12LWRvZC1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI3MTIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=f41077ba1f6ce5c6237a468019d5052f29d3548873dd1b2e166e6d4fe38e22db]
on behalf of our steadfast friends at Stand Together Against Racism
and Radicalism in the Services, Inc. (STARRS) against the U.S.
Department of Defense for records regarding the U.S. Air Force
Academy’s diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) plans (_Stand
Together Against Racism and Radicalism in the Services, Inc. v. U.S.
Department of Defense_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33634&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3N0YXJycy12LWRvZC1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI3MTIvXV8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=13106caf3bc756b938867684b8cd7156a2b5a1a8e6b08362499d16bcc7e51efb
_(No. 1:24-cv-02712)).

We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after
the U.S. Air Force Academy failed to adequately respond to two Freedom
of Information Act (FOIA) requests concerning DEI tracking at the
Academy.

A November 2021 request seeks:

> An assessment mandated by the Superintendent to be produced by
> September 2013.
>
> “Measurements” referenced in Annex 2, Goal D5 and Priorities 2.1
> and 2.2.
>
> Cadet wing demographics (e.g., race, ethnicity, and gender) upon
> entry and graduation for each year between 2003 and 2021 and
> corresponding representation in cadet commander positions at wing,
> group, and squadron levels.
An August 2024 request asks for:

> Records of cadet wing demographics (e.g., race, ethnicity, and
> gender) upon entry and graduation for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024
> and corresponding representation in cadet commander positions at
> wing, group, and squadron levels.
Included in the Air Force Academy’s DEI 2013 report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33635&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3N0YXJycy11c2FmYS0yMDEzLWRlaS0yMDI0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=f43548b2703690992717e52908d877c2b4099aad9d39df06aee51c9ab2ac0ef1]
is the statement by Superintendent Lt. Gen. Michael Gould:

> The USAFA Diversity and Inclusion Plan, 2012 Revision, is an action
> plan for D, E, & I that Team USAFA will implement over the next five
> years. The Annexes are a set of “living documents” for each
> Mission Partner and Directorate. My staff and I will evaluate the
> content found in the Annexes at the close of each fiscal year, so
> the first evaluation will take place in September 2013.
STARRS
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33645&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zdGFycnMudXMvYWJvdXQvXeKAmT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=13951bef6638ab1759e231d4efa5de5f3e10239739f6dc63e051ed39d8d1a796
mission “is to help educate
our fellow Americans regarding the criticality of having a military
that focuses solely on the essential readiness needed to fight and win
our nation’s wars.”
Our lawsuits and FOIA requests on Critical Race Theory and other
leftist extremism are extensive.

In June 2024, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=32830&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvd2VzdC1wb2ludC1taXNzaW9uLXN0YXRlbWVudC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=004873e5747d44b61bec7204a555a7b30c8fed67203cbc3e99b828851c238135]
the
Defense Department for records regarding deletion of the words
“Duty, Honor, Country” from the United States Military Academy at
West Point’s mission statement.

In March 2023, records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=29154&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYWlyLWZvcmNlLWFjYWRlbXktZm9jdXMtb24tY3J0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=4caf6e703f5d606ec1200b50bc0794f7d9a84bd3c75277a5683d76b8d2763cfe]
we
obtained from the Department of Defense showed the Air Force Academy
has made race and gender instruction a top priority in the training of
cadets.

In July 2023, we exposed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=29831&F=T&&hash=a1d5d4d84b34bce02a40178ecf93402b0c36948055236ddfe9d403c671271f61]
records from the United States Air Force Academy that included
instructional materials and emails that address topics such as
Critical Race Theory, “white privilege,” and Black Lives Matter.

In July 2022, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=27741&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctc3Vlcy1mb3ItbmF2YWwtYWNhZGVteS1jcnQtcmVjb3Jkcy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=1d9f055dac8c9b21d59ad07af1356b2dbbee49775af2f0fd0c1e983ba4bb65f0]
the Department of Defense for records related to the United States
Naval Academy (USNA) implementing Critical Race Theory (CRT) in the
training of naval recruits.

In June, we received records revealing Critical Race Theory
instruction at the U.S. Military Academy at West Poin
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33646&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY3J0LXByb3BhZ2FuZGEtYXQtd2VzdC1wb2ludC9ddD91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=db48bec74f3404518d9e9b96eea00e7107e7b33b35249695dd507426d9b37ec7
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=27536&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY3J0LXByb3BhZ2FuZGEtYXQtd2VzdC1wb2ludC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=61298f14d739336b97230b419ac55e576f2e2a6a98ce23b8bdca56be0aeb2f62]
One
training slide contains a graphic titled “MODERN-DAY SLAVERY IN THE
USA.” [Emphasis in original]

As you can see, DEI is an obsession for the Biden-Harris military. We
must expose and get it out root and branch.

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES OVER BREAK-IN BY SECRET SERVICE AGENTS COVERING
HARRIS

The Biden-Harris Secret Service broke into a business and tried to
cover it up – and they’re still trying to cover it up.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33627&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZGhzLXVzc3MtcGl0dHNmaWVsZC1icmVhay1pbi1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI3NTAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=44cdc99117a8c9c7d30e5034ce540fe86f56e3ffe86ceb913c2cf1602902da7d]
against the Department of Homeland Security for Secret Service records
about a break-in at a hair salon by Secret Service agents in
Pittsfield, MA, during a campaign fundraising visit by Vice President
Kamala Harris (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Homeland
Security_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33627&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZGhzLXVzc3MtcGl0dHNmaWVsZC1icmVhay1pbi1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI3NTAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=44cdc99117a8c9c7d30e5034ce540fe86f56e3ffe86ceb913c2cf1602902da7d]
(No,1:24-cv--02750)).

We sued after the Secret Service failed to respond to an August 12,
2024, FOIA request for:

* All emails and text messages of members of the Vice Presidential
Protective Detail regarding the break-in by Secret Service officials
of the Four One Three Salon in Pittsfield, Massachusetts on July 27,
2024, as described in various news media, such as
https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33628&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9ueXBvc3QuY29tLzIwMjQvMDgvMTEvdXPCrT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=35e69b97206f09ae77e1684824865ee7671bdf62856082e18532b9887b64f69b
news/secret-service-apologizes-to-salon-owner-over-break-in-bathroom-use
during-kamala-harris-event/
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33629&F=T&&hash=4d300712f0faade6f50dd5b616d2e1f8243d88d03201963bbce28698aa3508da].

* Communications of the special agent-in-charge of the Secret
Service field office in Boston, as well as Acting USSS Director Ronald
Rowe, Assistant Director Michael Plati, Assistant Director Brian
Lambert, and Assistant Director David Smith regarding the break-in of
the Four One Three Salon.

* Copies of all complaints filed against the Secret Service by
individuals or businesses impacted by Secret Service operations in
connection with the July 27 Harris campaign fundraiser in Pittsfield,
Massachusetts.

The _New York Post_ reported
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70613&L=33630&F=T&&hash=8e85d7c562527983a196059aa57e504eb08b729241bc73f4c571fddd63392eb8]
on August 11: “The Secret Service apologized to a salon owner in
Massachusetts who alleged that individuals broke into her business to
use the bathroom during the agency’s security work for a nearby Veep
Kamala Harris fundraiser.... [A] Secret Service officer covered a
camera outside her salon with tape.”

In September, following up on reports that the Biden Secret Service

[INSIDE JW] New Book "Rights and Freedoms in Peril, an Investigative Report on the Left’s Attack on America" on Sale Oct 15 [] My fourth Judicial Watch book, Rights and Freedoms in Peril: An Investigative Report on the Left's Attack on America, is set for publication on October 15. It details a long chain of abuses officials and political groups have made against the American people and is available for pre-order now at JudicialWatchBook.com [] My first three books were New York Times bestsellers. Since the release of the previous book, A Republic Under Assault, the Left has taken extraordinary steps to eradicate American liberty, motivated by a radical ideology whose adherents occupy the nation’s highest offices. Now, in Rights and Freedoms in Peril: An Investigative Report on the Left’s Attack on America (Threshold Editions/Gallery Books), I detail a long chain of abuses officials and politicians have made against the American people and call readers to battle for the soul and survival of America. You will be taken to the front lines where the progressive movement threatens America’s most venerable institutions, undermining the core principles that make this country a beacon of hope to the world. The Left has declared war on everything from the rule of law to a colorblind U.S. Constitution, border security, and government accountability. Their anti-American agenda must be stopped to save our country’s future. My previous book, A Republic Under Assault, The Left’s Ongoing Attack on American Freedom [], is a hard-hitting, fast-paced look at how the Radical Left and the Deep State tried to destroy the Trump presidency. It expands on the observation that “President Biden has a personal corruption problem, has obvious health challenges, and must manage internal warfare between his party’s corrupt corporate wing and its rising Communists. His moral claim on the presidency is rejected by a massive number of voters.” The first two bestselling books, The Corruption Chronicles [] and Clean House [] revealed what Judicial Watch, the world’s largest and most effective watchdog group, uncovered in its battles against Obama administration secrecy. Politicized indictments, ruined elections, invasions, and compromised politicians have placed our republican form of government in danger. There is a way forward, but we must be diligent about understanding the scope and detail of the peril. Shedding light on the truths and secrets of the left, Rights and Freedoms in Peril [] provides that way forward. JUDICIAL WATCH SUES AIR FORCE ACADEMY FOR DEI DETAILS Diversity, equity and inclusion, DEI, seems like Job No. 1 for our nation’s military academies. The Biden-Harris Defense Department is obsessed with indoctrinating our rising military leadership with woke, anti-American ideology. Judicial Watch filed yet another lawsuit to expose and stop this abuse of the young men and women in the Air Force Academy. We filed the lawsuit [] on behalf of our steadfast friends at Stand Together Against Racism and Radicalism in the Services, Inc. (STARRS) against the U.S. Department of Defense for records regarding the U.S. Air Force Academy’s diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) plans (Stand Together Against Racism and Radicalism in the Services, Inc. v. U.S. Department of Defense [ (No. 1:24-cv-02712)). We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after the U.S. Air Force Academy failed to adequately respond to two Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests concerning DEI tracking at the Academy. A November 2021 request seeks: An assessment mandated by the Superintendent to be produced by September 2013. “Measurements” referenced in Annex 2, Goal D5 and Priorities 2.1 and 2.2. Cadet wing demographics (e.g., race, ethnicity, and gender) upon entry and graduation for each year between 2003 and 2021 and corresponding representation in cadet commander positions at wing, group, and squadron levels. An August 2024 request asks for: Records of cadet wing demographics (e.g., race, ethnicity, and gender) upon entry and graduation for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024 and corresponding representation in cadet commander positions at wing, group, and squadron levels. Included in the Air Force Academy’s DEI 2013 report [] is the statement by Superintendent Lt. Gen. Michael Gould: The USAFA Diversity and Inclusion Plan, 2012 Revision, is an action plan for D, E, & I that Team USAFA will implement over the next five years. The Annexes are a set of “living documents” for each Mission Partner and Directorate. My staff and I will evaluate the content found in the Annexes at the close of each fiscal year, so the first evaluation will take place in September 2013. STARRS [ mission “is to help educate our fellow Americans regarding the criticality of having a military that focuses solely on the essential readiness needed to fight and win our nation’s wars.” Our lawsuits and FOIA requests on Critical Race Theory and other leftist extremism are extensive. In June 2024, we sued [] the Defense Department for records regarding deletion of the words “Duty, Honor, Country” from the United States Military Academy at West Point’s mission statement. In March 2023, records [] we obtained from the Department of Defense showed the Air Force Academy has made race and gender instruction a top priority in the training of cadets. In July 2023, we exposed [] records from the United States Air Force Academy that included instructional materials and emails that address topics such as Critical Race Theory, “white privilege,” and Black Lives Matter. In July 2022, we sued [] the Department of Defense for records related to the United States Naval Academy (USNA) implementing Critical Race Theory (CRT) in the training of naval recruits. In June, we received records revealing Critical Race Theory instruction at the U.S. Military Academy at West Poin [ [] One training slide contains a graphic titled “MODERN-DAY SLAVERY IN THE USA.” [Emphasis in original] As you can see, DEI is an obsession for the Biden-Harris military. We must expose and get it out root and branch. JUDICIAL WATCH SUES OVER BREAK-IN BY SECRET SERVICE AGENTS COVERING HARRIS The Biden-Harris Secret Service broke into a business and tried to cover it up – and they’re still trying to cover it up. We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit [] against the Department of Homeland Security for Secret Service records about a break-in at a hair salon by Secret Service agents in Pittsfield, MA, during a campaign fundraising visit by Vice President Kamala Harris (Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security [] (No,1:24-cv--02750)). We sued after the Secret Service failed to respond to an August 12, 2024, FOIA request for: All emails and text messages of members of the Vice Presidential Protective Detail regarding the break-in by Secret Service officials of the Four One Three Salon in Pittsfield, Massachusetts on July 27, 2024, as described in various news media, such as news/secret-service-apologizes-to-salon-owner-over-break-in-bathroom-use during-kamala-harris-event/ []. Communications of the special agent-in-charge of the Secret Service field office in Boston, as well as Acting USSS Director Ronald Rowe, Assistant Director Michael Plati, Assistant Director Brian Lambert, and Assistant Director David Smith regarding the break-in of the Four One Three Salon. * Copies of all complaints filed against the Secret Service by individuals or businesses impacted by Secret Service operations in connection with the July 27 Harris campaign fundraiser in Pittsfield, Massachusetts. The New York Post reported [] on August 11: “The Secret Service apologized to a salon owner in Massachusetts who alleged that individuals broke into her business to use the bathroom during the agency’s security work for a nearby Veep Kamala Harris fundraiser.... [A] Secret Service officer covered a camera outside her salon with tape.” In September, following up on reports that the Biden Secret Service denied President Trump’s requests for additional Secret Service protection, we sued [] the Department of Homeland Security for all Secret Service and other records regarding potential increased protective services to former President Trump’s security detail prior to the attempt on his life at his July 13 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania. In August we released records showing that the Secret Service has made it a top priority that “diversity and inclusion is not just ‘talked about’ – but demonstrated by all employees through ‘EVERY ACTION, EVERY DAY.’” [Emphasis in original] On July 31, we reported [] that the United States Secret Service completely denied multiple FOIA requests for documents about the assassination attempt on former President Trump. On July 22, we announced [] a lawsuit for records of an incident in which a Secret Service agent assigned to protect Vice President Kamala Harris reportedly got into a scuffle with colleagues In February we released [] documents showing that Assistant Director Michael Plati ordered his staff not to respond to a request for information from Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s head of security. To be blunt, the Secret Service is a dysfunctional agency overcome by political corruption, incompetence, as well as diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) obsession. And, as the near assassinations of Trump show, this dysfunction is deadly dangerous. BIDEN-HARRIS ADMINISTRATION SUES LANDLORDS THAT BAN TENANTS WITH CRIMINAL RECORDS Leftists seem to like people who break the law. If you’re a landlord, they will force you to take them in. Our Corruption Chronicles_ blog explains [ To keep with an Obama era housing rule that prohibits landlords from banning tenants with criminal records, the Biden administration is going after property owners that use background checks to screen prospective renters. Under the civil rights law known as the Fair Housing Act [.], housing discrimination is prohibited based on race or color, religion, sex, national origin, familial status or disability, but Obama’s U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) issued an order [] in 2016 adding criminals to the protected class. In the document Helen R. Kanovsky, then HUD General Counsel, wrote that a policy or practice that restricts access to housing on the basis of criminal history has a disparate impact on individuals of a particular race, national origin, or other protected class and that violates the Fair Housing Act even if the discrimination is unintended. “Because of widespread racial and ethnic disparities in the U.S. criminal justice system, criminal history-based restrictions on access to housing are likely disproportionately to burden African Americans and Hispanics,” HUD’s top legal official wrote. To abide by the Obama order, the Biden administration has aggressively pursued landlords that do not want to rent to criminals. This month the Department of Justice (DOJ) filed a lawsuit against the owners and managers of a residential property in Kinloch, Missouri, for engaging in a pattern or practice of race and/or color discrimination against prospective black tenants by banning renters with felony convictions and certain other criminal histories. The agency alleges in its complaint [] that the defendants violated the Fair Housing Act under the same skewed interpretation delivered by Obama’s HUD General Counsel. The residential multifamily rental apartment complex, Suburban Heights, is around 15 miles from St. Louis and has 102 units in six two-story buildings. Since 2015 management has enforced a categorical ban on tenants with criminal histories, “which are known to have significant statistical disparities,” the DOJ writes, adding that by choosing to use that policy defendants deterred prospective black tenants from applying to rent and excluded them from housing opportunities at their property. “It is well documented and known that there are statistical Black-White racial disparities in conviction and incarceration rates,” the DOJ complaint states. “Incarceration data indicates that Black individuals are significantly more likely than White individuals to have the types of convictions covered by Suburban Heights’ Criminal History Ban. This is true nationwide and, to an even greater extent, in St. Louis City and St. Louis County. Black individuals are at least four times, and often more than five times, more likely than White individuals to be incarcerated in prisons, both at any given point in time and over the course of their lifetimes.” As an example, the agency offers that the national black-white disparities in prison incarceration rates are consistently five to one. In the St. Louis area, the black-white incarceration disparity is worse at seven to one, according to the federal complaint. “These Black-White statistical disparities in incarceration rates are an appropriate proxy and the best available evidence for the statistical disparities in rates of the types of convictions covered by Suburban Heights’ Criminal History Ban,” the lawsuit says, adding that the property managers chose to adopt and enforce a policy which predictably excludes black tenants at a higher rate than white tenants. The DOJ is using the same argument to go after local governments [] [ law enforcement agencies across the country that have implemented measures to curb an epidemic of crime, drugs and gang violence in rental properties. The popular laws, enacted by thousands of cities nationwide are commonly known as “crime-free” and “nuisance” programs that restrict housing based on criminal and arrest records and punish landlords and tenants with excessive calls to police and emergency services or those engaged in criminal activity. To improve living conditions in mainly low-income rentals 2,000 cities across 48 states have adopted crime-free and nuisance policies, according to the DOJ, which has legally challenged many of the measures in the last few years claiming that they are discriminatory and therefore violate federal law because they “unfairly penalize communities of color [ Assistant Attorney General Kristen Clarke, who heads the Biden DOJ’s Civil Rights Division, claims that “even when well-intentioned, these programs can disrupt lives, force families into homelessness and result in loss of jobs, schooling and opportunities for people who are disproportionately low-income people of color – all in violation of federal law.” Until next week, [Contribute] [] [advertisement] [] [32x32x1] [] [32x32x2] [] [32x32x3] [] [32x32x3] [] Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St Sw Ste 800 Washington, DC 20024 202.646.5172 © 2017 - 2024, All Rights Reserved Manage Email Subscriptions [] |

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5yJWhbV9y2-7vzhWK-7tAQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7MJ-P0S_~) [NO](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5yJWhbV9y2-7vzhWK-7tAQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7MJ-P0S_~) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5yJWhbV9y2-7vzhWK-7tAQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7MJ-P0S_~)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d23d58ed83e34cfe889728e9ab680896&_e=NColOrEHWFNLHtAnH5MbSau5JWIBoQtuhj7BhET2dod7V22vw6SjCCX1t-4pEwTfkXrLokTBXCU1UAKOs0hd-eMTQfr9k3k8gz3CZ01Hgzl8c-xmvJjnux8VOymSPc7EkSMBJkfr-ZUddazTFMMYnmPMI9n13Oz4l5L19_BtY8kJT6GSeiGxtbINgX7Vbh3ddI3lqslstQ3wnKpfvZMstfLK6cA_xZEWWh5pNbij1csGecJbBY546hGxTpeOIcZgrnkhwGwQGABnabrcLP2cNxHgjpuTFimrvVaJKt4ehc973wA2K7u8zkZMHi2GL9OB7Gw9ihWh6aZcYORUJkbJLvMfcOkjyNxFJpYAErjdqk3yxDRmAVNTvOnloZv-xRzbHT71aFs8jPtcaXzw505QGR5mj7kigUlyVdk75KZRujXeX11mOhwWBJghfMJJ2l-maYVtc8RwE6E_01p1MujPGpkuBMU_j2AbjWe2LlyKeCY%3D) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d23d58ed83e34cfe889728e9ab680896&_e=NColOrEHWFNLHtAnH5MbSau5JWIBoQtuhj7BhET2dod7V22vw6SjCCX1t-4pEwTfkXrLokTBXCU1UAKOs0hd-eMTQfr9k3k8gz3CZ01Hgzl8c-xmvJjnux8VOymSPc7EkSMBJkfr-ZUddazTFMMYnmPMI9n13Oz4l5L19_BtY8kJT6GSeiGxtbINgX7Vbh3ddI3lqslstQ3wnKpfvZMstfLK6cA_xZEWWh5pNbij1csGecJbBY546hGxTpeOIcZgrnkhwGwQGABnabrcLP2cNxHgjpuTFimrvVaJKt4ehc973wA2K7u8zkZMHi2GL9OB7Gw9ihWh6aZcYORUJkbJLmdlMym242n3fAsUj_EimaTrQaclQDl10l4E8D5pH2QQ_QfM16_qSPCmEPB3csI9_2Cr8PSLb8_0K1yixBgcEEo60VrLuznNvFWsFu-Mdx6mT77eHjRyi1ZpxUAsnpdb5zWM6XXMfVhTW8icvLtTsCs%3D) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

What makes [hear.com's](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d23d58ed83e34cfe889728e9ab680896&_e=NColOrEHWFNLHtAnH5MbSau5JWIBoQtuhj7BhET2dod7V22vw6SjCCX1t-4pEwTfkXrLokTBXCU1UAKOs0hd-eMTQfr9k3k8gz3CZ01Hgzl8c-xmvJjnux8VOymSPc7EkSMBJkfr-ZUddazTFMMYnmPMI9n13Oz4l5L19_BtY8kJT6GSeiGxtbINgX7Vbh3ddI3lqslstQ3wnKpfvZMstfLK6cA_xZEWWh5pNbij1csGecJbBY546hGxTpeOIcZgrnkhwGwQGABnabrcLP2cNxHgjpuTFimrvVaJKt4ehc973wA2K7u8zkZMHi2GL9OB7Gw9ihWh6aZcYORUJkbJLuKctwWz_qUh7uDc9wYHlJ6A7ns0ZFKFnN5nckhyg7tlvDwjKkWA6VltWgZVKXAjPYjswxvIDoXCfKjWbgsoaRVMimb0mi5fM_akiHR18MDIYWz2mg3PxBsnBhWB4XaNbHDgjd0Ob-KX9ex81-VT0-s%3D) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

| |
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/mEZlIHgjpZaJwvCKYw6eCw~~/AARclAA~) [NO](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/mEZlIHgjpZaJwvCKYw6eCw~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/mEZlIHgjpZaJwvCKYw6eCw~~/AARclAA~)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Restore Our Nation

name: Team Carris
subject: Less Than Four Weeks to Go: We Need Your Support Now More Than Ever!
body:
Peter,With just under four weeks until Election Day, our momentum is stronger than ever! Every day, Jim Carris and our team are reaching out to voters across the 10th District, and the response has been incredible.Meanwhile, our opponent is desperately trying to paint Jim and all of us as extremists. But should we be surprised? **It 's typical for a far-left incumbent to use shock value and scare tactics to squeeze money from voters while voting 100% down party lines and failing to deliver for the voters at home. ** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-r/) But that's their fear talking - the incumbent is afraid, and for good reason! **[The Carris campaign is on the radar and more and more people are aware that the 1oth District can be flipped](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-y/)**. How do we know?**The Numbers**
**We 've raised over $150,000 in the third quarter of 2024**, tripling our numbers month-over-month and quarter-over-quarter. This is the most any congressional candidate in the 10th District has raised since Bob Dold's 2016 campaign. It's huge news, but it also means our work is paying off, and we can't slow down now.**The Endorsements**
In a significant show of **hometown support** , Jim proudly announced [the endorsement](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-j/) of two influential Lincolnshire leaders this week: Elizabeth Brandt, Mayor of Lincolnshire, and Leslie Munger, former Illinois Comptroller and Lincolnshire resident. This follows endorsements from [Congressman Darin LaHood (IL-16)](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-t/), [Former Senator Mark Kirk (IL) and Former Congressman Bob Dold (IL-10)](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-i/), and [McHenry County Board Chair Michael Buehler](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-d/). **These are just a few of the many vocal supporters in Jim 's corner. ****The Public Support**
We are painting the 10th District red, Carris-style! **Not only have we distributed tens of thousands of walk cards and attended dozens of events, but we have also received more than[ 500 requests for yard signs](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-h/) across all corners of the District**. Our supporters are proud to show that they're planning to fight for change with their vote - just like Jim will in Congress. With three weeks to go, we need your help. **Your investment is being used for what matters most: voter outreach and education. **We've just ordered another batch of yard signs, we have more digital ads and mailers planned to reach voters, and every dollar goes toward spreading Jim's message of lower taxes, safer streets, closing our border, and a brighter future for our children.**[Will you contribute $50 right now to help us hit our goal and finish this quarter strong?](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-k/)** With your contribution today, we'll continue to reach every street, cul-de-sac, and neighborhood to make sure voters know their taxes CAN and should be lower, their streets CAN and should be safer, and their children CAN and should have a brighter future than they've been promised by the current leadership. [PLEASE DONATE $50 TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-u/) Thank you for standing with Jim and for believing in the vision we're fighting for. _Julia_ Team Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-o/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-m/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-c/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjylug-tlidtddjku-q/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-sjylug-tlidtddjku-a/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-sjylug-tlidtddjku-f/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-sjylug-tlidtddjku-z/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-sjylug-l-v) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-u-sjylug-tlidtddjku-e/)

subject: A Gold Mine Accident, Shifting Poll Numbers, and an Angry Alligator

## Hurricane Milton Recovery Continues
Hurricane Milton's aftermath in Florida has left [at least 16 dead](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFupDAQQL_GdCDP2Cy4cHHSiW6vOUUp0YCHZRKDV8bLKn8fbfrUT3p6eu_X8UoSZb_9o419WdJIc5GTR9A1YI12tFXwCzOyqdhDh31nsHdYrX5i51zbWjC9MR1NhlxLl0vo0QJh31XiUaMFDQhaO-saQA2OeZmoCz0sqKzmICXl5iPJXlZe4lc6OTdz2qro11LuhzJ_FA4KB5rmnZ9Hc0svrHB4-69wiHJy_bgHKnwoHDaJJe31kjLPdJR6feQsM-1cl0zzJ-eXywwSlPkLYNvWONdW2Yf7U2KU49Ipq28bSfxpKL8sOT1-BwAA___r0WG7) and over 2 million without power as rescue crews continued to assist those stranded by floodwaters on Friday. The White House said Friday that [1,000 federal personnel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7Fu7CAQRb8GOqxhzHvggiKNu02b0gIzrImwWeHRWvv30aZPd6UrnaPzdVtuodRy3D_DTp5zW8LK5UmLBqVRoVmMTD4TIY2SvLbo7IhuQrl5cDoaiO4fBINhjKNZbYpuyjZidqBl8QhoNGjUAJOZBo2gJ6Icg01OZxQGKBVuffhu5eCNcn21J_VhbbusfmN-nGL8EDgLnK_rGtZ4HnSd71_g_J4C571UbocKmanvgTfVaX1TXopybp1PlWvrJQWBs-w-Pa5Sazn_W2HgvodSf3X8R_3T408AAAD__x_qXcE) in Florida have conducted over 4,200 rescues and delivered 1.2 million meals, with 1.6 million more meals planned for delivery. One of the more dramatic rescues occurred Thursday when a Coast Guard helicopter saved a man hanging on to a cooler about 30 miles off the coast. [You can see the rescue here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQhJ8Gd1iwJsEUFNfQ5dorrbVZJ5ywiWBjK29_8vV_M9OMNJ--P4_pgSmn_fkbN_K8lgkXTgdNWkkNEsxkuuhXIqChI68tjHaA0UH38uSsAatvczRmIXLo1Iho5_uixhkH7JIHBUYrDVopZ1yvQWlHtM5o46hXEEZRTFxq_7eknV-05m85qPZL2brsX8zvJoZfAoKAcJ5n_2nIJeL3GggIjUv9Cgg7ne0q5FR2AeG6FRC0ukILCEvBxvL5wRplpbZ8qMm5IMsF34xpl7gyVbmlzGWXR4pUBAR7u4NxblTKCghd9fF9ppxTu1th1HPDlP-T8g_iDg__AgAA__8zdG54). There were signs of [life returning to normal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFu6zAMAL_G3hyItGJZg4a3ZMtbOxq0RMYsZCtQ1AT9-yLdOx5uOOA-rsuVNOtx-087hyZlodj0yQuYAXBAu9g-BWFGHnsO4HB2I84e-y2QgPNkpugsRRRKRoCSPTv0I8wivQY0aMEAgjHe-hOgAc8sK7k0g2BnDSdtpZ4-ix5tY8nf5cn1FMve57C1dn90478OLx1e6H7w6_FWb6hNY-YOL9tXrRrp4GHX3MoxSC5VEw1OJrOu7OOE_izIK4txjiNhhNUy9DWk-0tz1sfkOmtuO2n-Lbc_RjwD_gQAAP__Kk5f3A) Friday as several theme parks and airports were scheduled to fully reopen.
## Gold Mine Accident Leaves One Dead
Authorities on Friday identified the victim of [a Colorado gold mine accident](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAQQL8Gb7aOgxh7YKhUeUuXqupoETicq7CxMEmUv6_SvdMb3vL0vs_z2XHibflwK9ka8-x85TvNElqJLepZN8FGIiTVkJUGB6NwGLG5WuixdxG9GcgEZWIIoLwaTr2SJ0UOGrYIqCVIlACjHjuJIEeieHEmDDKi0ECBay7dT-atXimmZ75T6Xxem2Svte6HUG8CJ4GTu_iNHke35JcWOH19CpzWW6q8J2p3yi_U4vadQnvbApWl5NsWWp9TLi7kduWN2hwje3bpEDgdNZenUBMHod6l1AZgBNMUG_YHp8RHb4SGZXWc_prqP4vuFn8DAAD__3LRaSg) that trapped nearly two dozen tourists hundreds of feet underground as Patrick Weier, the group's tour guide. According to reports, [two groups of 12 tourists](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j71u9CAQAJ8GurNg4TN2QfE17i5tSouf5bwnDCcbmeTto0ufbqSRRprP-3p3lKk8PtyOtqW6utDowlWKm4Qb6FXzaBMioOJopYHJKJhm4JsV6OPoDTrpgg5pUsoInbRKcxq1N4mTBQFaCglSiFnPgwQhZ8TknYmTTMC0wEitHsOzUmkbpvxdLzyGUHee7dba62TqP4OFwdJ7H7wPb8dgKdhPBos7GoWMbwxlesb-FfO_Uvlh46tTznSOhmnx2B3l32r7Y_Ky8BMAAP__iaFUeQ), including children, were touring Mollie Kathleen Gold Mine in Cripple Creek when an elevator malfunctioned, leaving one dead, four injured and the groups stuck below ground. Authorities [quickly rescued 11 people](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAUhH8N3rB4zwTMwNCFLV07WhSeY1psLExi5d9XqdSxy91y0n36Pq7T1aecttu7X8m2uUw-tPSgCQQH5Cgn2UU7EyENHVnQOOoBR4PdYpVCjQpmDIMRMSD40SuKRo-jiRB0lywKlCAAQQgjTQ8owBDNn17HEWZkUlBMrdT-q6StLTTnZ3lQ7UNZu2yX1vaDDW8MHUN3nmd_P3wr0T9fA4buaKU-GbqNzuNVvqWyMXSvW4YOxF-sJedE_Nu3JRNt_FZy5GvaiIeSS_Wx8Fb9vlPklY5wJ4ZOXxSoQV6E0AxdV23cz5RzOpRmUtxWn_IvZ_tH28PiTwAAAP__kIZtCg), including two children, but the other 12 remained in the mine for about six hours. Colorado [requires daily inspections](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGP4yAUBOBfgzsseNixXVDkdHKXa1JcaRF4JO-EwQfY1v77VdJvNSNNM_r-3paboUDx-cesqKtPi7GVDlyk4BI4dEvXOO0RAVWDWg4wDgrGCZqXHtFfHt71vfC9krbvRzEYO4wXN2Fne9WQBgGdFBKkEFM3tRKEnBD9wwxulB5YJ9BRTbn9lyjWF_rwlQ7MrU1rE_Sr1q0wdWUwM5jP82zXEt8bgxkj3wuDOeL5jk8veGA2gddstg0dl5JnLHZHxylym0LKxiW-UkRufMXM8f9O24qx8tUEv0dbKUUGs8n8epVFPcc7U3Oy5Jj6_evNhGe5Y96arN12UghULgPrxHM1FD636w-Kh4bvAAAA__8XeXYl) of tourist mine attractions and transportation systems, but the last inspection date and records were not immediately available.
## Northern Lights Seen Across U.S. and Europe
A powerful solar storm triggered stunning northern lights displays, known as aurora borealis, across the U.S. and the world this week. [You can see photos of the colorful event here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn8N3rDgTIIZGLp4S9eO1jk-4quILwIat_--Svcu3_JJ70nv4zJfkDPvt3e8U2xJZrw2ftJsjbagwc2uW2MiAho6itbD6AcYA3RbPJ_XIYyrB-9O47IkFwYfTAKLpzAaM3QcwYCzxoI1JrjQWzA2EKUF_TraBMoZWrlJ6T-F97ZRyj_ypNJf5d7luLX2qGp4UzApmI7j6PGbpb5eBdOLrWCy5jVWwbRLaRuVXWe-ba1q_CpSUC9SCDNXXSVj0SljIf3YpEntSlwfB-fM9eyVM7c7cv6Tt39aPCP8BgAA___l62Ae). The geomagnetic storm, [rated 4 out of 5 by NOAA](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAUheGnwRsWXIixB4Yu3tK1o4XxJabCEMFN3L59laprt086y9H_cV2uLqaYb-_uQEuhLM5TfOIiBZfAQS-622xABFQdWmlgNArGCbrdGqW2EMbBrxc_KNBmEKMbzOAlXFajRBctCNBSSJBCTHrqJQg5IYbVmW2UAZgWuEUqtf8sMdOOIX2XJ9bel6NLdie6N6beGMwM5vM8-7z6jGd77QzmFxnMj8b_5B61VMfXUtGl2Ph9L1QabyW5yhuVevBcKu1YM0_xtlPjhF-u8eqzk0ZPE3TVbvczphTbYJgWt8PF9PuH_snztPATAAD__-25aTA), triggered widespread illuminations beyond its usual polar regions. The skies in Europe and the U.S. saw vivid magenta and green hues, reaching as far south as San Antonio, Texas. Although severe solar storms [can disrupt power and radio signals](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb_G7oiYMfFAQfGadHntlhaGwWaFTQRsov37Vbbf7l6d5uh83Je7Szmd2393sO2xLM739OQFpAAUqBY1BhuZkaeRLRBqmlAbHHdLVyMB2avAgfTE8-w1GTJ-DtI7WsdkUaICCQhSGmUugBIMc1wdBQ0RByU5pF7q5bOks-8c83d5cr34cozZ7r0_2jD9G_A24M09Tn61N3qf2pPP_F5ftVQnzlL7zvUUOW17b6KV7KpovdRDbFwOt53ckxdgFGie5qsmULDqKa6rI6eiDLQqUmO14fFKOac206DkdriUf336H3meFn8CAAD__8mqZyw), no immediate issues were reported.

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does. But now, a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry, and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade. It's new IX hearing aid. And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations. It’s no wonder IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America. What makes IX hearing aid so special? It’s one of the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing. This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small. The result? An unprecedented amount of power and clarity. This means that IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for unparalleled, crystal clear sound. “It's not just about volume,” explains founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. ## Chemical Leak Claims Two Lives in Deer Park
A hydrogen sulfide leak at Deer Park's Pemex plant on Thursday killed two plant workers and injured 35. The leak prompted a shelter-in-place order for Deer Park and Pasadena before [officials determined](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LtuxCAQQNGvwR0WzIAfBUWkyN2miaKU1hiGNRFerzDZx99HSZ_6Nlfn8zSfKOV0Ob_Rxq4-4j6Tr-nGs1ZSgwQzmya4RYVRN-x0D0OPFjvTrM7gqHDADpcYEewCyGNvRkWdid4TNsmBAqOVBq3sgNhGpoEIRxutWhR1wigOqe6lrStXftAR83O_cWn9vjXZrbVeD4EvAiYBEy3-wvejPe-_WcD08S5g0jIwBZkuX9-Fg6RYuUi_8pY8ZVk4Mx0sr7zxQ0byKaf6FDAddS9PgVMKAl-1Nr2ynbVNceF6Tzmno-uFUeeNUv6bqf_h3Bz8BAAA__-kcmY1) there was no threat to the public in the area, despite the presence of an odor in the air after the leak. Harris County Sheriff Ed Gonzalez said [the leak occurred during work on a flange](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAURp8Gb1hwAZMMDF28pWtH69pcYhT8I6Cx8_ZVsnf7pE9HRzo_t-GGMcX1_o0LuXqGbcCpxicNUnAJHPSgG-9G4a-yISctXKwyqtPN7KbgJ_AgJ4tS0HjtrDJeGWMRgtUSmuhAgJZCghTmolQbCC-I6mqCEaPAjmlBPtYtt3WmSieWkF7bk3I7bUuT3FzrXpj6YtAz6I_jaKexrHSU98-gf08G_YfkOy108j3hWvn88nm708rLbwrRE0-ED-6JMt8xPxj0TXZ-P2JKsXSWaXFfMKaPtv6X4engLwAA__8pBGF0) at the Mexican state-owned oil refinery. The 35 injured people were either transported to the hospital or treated at the scene. Hydrogen sulfide is a [toxic, colorless gas with a strong odor](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ_GdEbrtY1J4eIad7n2SrTBS7BiYgS-kLz9L9L_zUwz0jf6_l2HK6Wcnve_tLCv76kMNNb04kGBVCjRDKaJ_gbxohr2ymHvtNWdaWbf657jaJmN7TUrisYYC53D0V2AJ2iSR0CjQKEC22vdTkw9kb7YycINqBMGOKZatrbOXPlN-5Q_5cVbO5alyX6udd2F_iMwCAzHcbT_d6ol0uccCAx7LdtHYHjysZ9FNZWnwHByBQYFZyiBYZx5SSNlmZke8ouSKy_8lpF5kyttD4HB2Q6NQwfgBIZm83E9Us5p75wwcF8o5e-z-pupl8efAAAA__90PGh-) similar to rotten eggs.
## Suzanne Simpson Search Continues, Husband Arrested
Real estate investor Brad Simpson [has been arrested](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFurDAQRb_GdEb22OClcPEaun1tSjTAsIxiY4Qd2OTro90-3ZWudI50Pu7DHTnw9viPkXx5LmnAqfBJg1ZSgwQ72Gr2o5o7XZHXDm7ONKa11eoBHLXOdYtxnTXkgFAvY6dGRA3N1FbsQYHVSoNWzc2YeiG8IZquWRo1KmyFVTRzSUddVir0xLyE73TSUU8pVsGvpexZmH8CegH9dV31NOaNrvz6BfSvKaDPXz-4bSQzxz2nTUbOmbeHfBNlTGWlQ6YQU5Y7Hp9yT4EnEtBXh5_3i0Pg3Dph1SMih7e7_NXi9PAbAAD__yk0Y8g) in connection with his wife's disappearance. Suzanne Simpson, luxury real estate agent and mother of three, was last seen Sunday night by a neighbor who saw the couple engaged in a physical altercation outside their home near San Antonio. That neighbor says that Brad Simpson drove away from his home and returned a few hours later. [He reported his wife missing the next day](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLmupDAQRb8GskJ2sbkDB5OQvUknRAWUwZJZZBdL__2oO3_xvUc6Ov9--h_ywW_zX1rZyuP2nkbxF_dagUbAqq_yyQ5qeumcrW7RtGVdNlW-WDaOFGki045YD8Y0-tUMZjI4loQt5t6iwkorjVrVpiwLx2SIylftajUoarJK8eRlj4UsLPxQcuG9XxyLcV_zYBeRI2Xlnwy7DLv7vgu3Pxvf6bNn2J0pw-7LwbqvEM7njG-ITAE4CQkDzbwJrD4lv81ATjjCQVHewM8YzuQvhiP66_MdwznAcqaBtgkoRk7CUx7tdNw-BJ-aNqvUvJIPXz35Lddl8X8AAAD__4Nkcek). The couple's fight at home came after [a "disturbance"](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGy4yAMRb8Gd8oAtpO4oNjG3dt2y4wAEZjBxgOy87xfv-PXb6PmjKR77p-v1xemnNb3b1zI8HcoL3ScDnopCUqDHl5D542VflIdGfXQz0c_9vehi6anp6QJFfkg7d3Z8UETBhuwD0STG7tktNSDkkorOT77_hYIn4j9NIZRWol3MUjyiUu9cSSmb2whn-WgenNl6bKJzFsT_S-hZ6Hn9dxK4wsJPV-XhZ6VvIYSet4brPRpQs8upnwpQUgrZthi4QKVMmEjDyXAklq7-M9HWMoCyFAT_z3BlX3leoLLu4VY9trAUiiVwKeG20ZYr00MTBUwZ3qThyOVTCsDZqbqkFNZ4ZM4QtytPYWeu2r89rlStftDDPK9YMo_jvy_zg-j_wUAAP__WymJ2Q) at a party at The Argyle Country Club earlier in the evening. Brad Simpson has been charged with misdemeanors stemming from the fight at the couple's home.
## 120th Red River Shootout Today
The Texas Longhorns (5-0) face the Oklahoma Sooners (4-1) today in the Red River Shootout, marking the 120th occurrence of one of college football's most famed rivalries and the first occurrence with both schools as members of the Southeastern Conference. It is the first time since 1984 that [Texas enters the matchup ranked first in the AP poll](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAQRp_GdIPs4TeFi9vQ5bZbosGMg7UGR_YIkrdfbfotP-mTztH5us93CjEcj_-0s5WXTzM5CSfPRoNBwHZuq9Uuer2Ziq0ZcByarunbarN6XLUfeupGgwuakYhdOyzaNLcBeXBVsKixNdqg0d3YNLVnGomaW-c7vWjqVat5DZJyLRsLv6j4-E4n59qlvYp2E3kW1fxTOCmcruuqfXqVZ8pSfh8KJ8oSXOSicHJ-UTgVdgUOvrgI5HBSzG8IBQxq2WBnlnA8wKcMRwIDHybQsX7mCOk70pZ2AhKQjcFTyFW26_MKMYbSD6rVj51C_AjKX8FOiz8BAAD__x-Ab38). The Longhorns are 14.5-point favorites and will try to avenge last year's loss to Oklahoma, currently ranked 18th in the AP poll. Quarterback [Quinn Ewers will start for Texas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2SpCAYAJ8GMyz4QNGA4BKyufRC65OfkTqUGWB15u23dvKNO-iu_ndbbhhTPO5_cfe6vUJe0LZ4-oUzyoGCXGTn9MrczDuvuYJJiUGMstu0lG4Mw6RWpxRMOLjBWrCzdbOQInDZRQ0MJGccOBsmIfrgcUIU8xAGtjIciWTexZZL3zbf_AtrSO98-tLbvHdJb609KhF_CBgC5rqu3tfH8QMJGJtT8ndPQ85txZQImNpyeRMwCwETHQEjueIzA0HAHJly-nFQm48Qy17pc6XPr3gc1F--VFoblkbPSks8MdH8P-GWd-yKdo8rphTrqIhk9x1j-hS2346dGr4DAAD___jqbvE) after missing the previous two games due to injury, spelled by redshirt freshman phenom Arch Manning.

Friend,

Amber Lavigne was helping her 13-year-old daughter clean her room when she found a chest binder — an undergarment used to flatten breasts.

Amber was shocked when her daughter explained that it had been given to her by a school counselor who was secretly advising her about gender transitioning.

To make matters worse, the counselor told Amber’s daughter that she should not tell her parents about any of it.

Outraged, Amber confronted both the principal of her daughter’s taxpayer school and the school district superintendent.
_**“This was no accident: my daughter’s public school counselor deliberately tried to keep me in the dark, encouraging my daughter’s gender transition and encouraging her to hide it from me. When school officials found out, they actually defended the counselor’s actions, trampling on my constitutional rights at every turn. I deserve to know what’s happening to my child — the secrecy needs to stop.”**_
— Amber Lavigne

**I**.
When Tom Brady was asked how he became the greatest quarterback of all time despite being among the slowest, least athletic, and at NFL draft pick #199, the least valued recruit, he had a simple response:
**" There's more to quarterbacking than how you throw a fucking ball."**
Being an NFL QB is primarily a _leadership_ position that requires cognitive and social skills -- not mere physical ability. Of course, if you can't throw a ball, that's disqualifying; you are no quarterback. But throwing well is the bare minimum. Quarterbacking demands so much more.
Similarly, here's what I say to fellow Democrats who don't understand why Harris might lose to Trump: _there 's more to democracy than fucking voting._
Elections are essential. And the peaceful transfer of power is the _[sine qua non](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cfa3b1d2-045b-4c15-9bd5-0f59b9e1306f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ of democracy. Trump is no democrat, lowercase d, because he only believes in elections that he wins.
That by itself -- _if_ Democrats' hands were clean -- would be enough for Trump to lose. But our hands are _not_ clean. Because Trump's anti-election stance has done more than lose him votes. It has made partisan Democrats _crazy_ : in thrall to a political fundamentalism that justifies any means -- even _undemocratic_ means -- devoted to the end of stopping Trump.
**II.**
When Americans say "democracy," what we really mean is "liberal democracy." Liberalism _and_ democracy: not just elections and voting, but freedom of speech and freedom of conscience, the rule of law, civil rights and civil liberties.
Indeed, there is a famously American understanding that the right to vote is _meaningless_ without ironclad rights to speech, thought, worship, and a fair trial when you are accused of a crime, which accusation should itself be the result of a fair and impartial investigation.
Speech in particular is paramount.
Language is the midwife of thought. If you take away my right to speak freely, you take away my right to think freely. And if I can't even think straight, you don't _have_ to take away my right to vote. I have already lost it.
Democracy isn't just elections. It is the American constitution, all of its amendments, and everything they stand for.
**III.**
**While the Democratic party 's commitment to **_**general elections**_**is strong, our commitment to everything else democratic has withered in the era of Trump.**
Here are just a few examples:
* We [canceled](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d60b934-ec9e-42ba-8e8a-88a8c632de5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) several 2024 primary elections, misled the American people about the health of the president, and thereby deprived every young, healthy, talented Democratic governor and senator of an opportunity to run.
* We [appointed](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8fb883a6-3343-40a4-a661-5198d7040b8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as Biden's successor a person who got 0 votes and who lost badly when she did face voters in a primary.
* We [pressured](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/eb648777-194b-429e-be37-78632a1655e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) social media companies to censor legitimate dissent about COVID-19 policy -- and called those ideas 'disinformation.'
* We [pressured](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5239177e-98e5-4571-b476-bc02c865fe70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) social media companies to suppress the Hunter Biden laptop story, which could have swung the outcome of the 2020 presidential election.
* [As I've argued elsewhere](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/031bab02-27a2-4b75-8020-10678178cdf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), some - though not all - of the cases brought against Donald Trump reflect an abuse of prosecutorial discretion that should never, ever exist in a real democracy.
* And many of our leading thinkers and leaders -- Fran Lebowitz, Hillary Clinton, and John Kerry, just to name a few -- now want us to ['dissolve the Supreme Court'](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bc6a9c73-32da-4154-b423-bda24d190e49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [criminalize incorrect speech](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e7cd24e2-914a-4867-bc50-156056ed88ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [reconsider](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/042ec115-1505-4055-9948-f1c45962eb12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the 1st Amendment because it makes it harder to govern.

**IV.**
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8a04c4b7-96db-462a-9516-e9edf9bf01d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_The New York Times_ , circa August 31, 2024.
Democrats' abandonment of _liberalism_ in favor of _progressivism_ is really the root of the problem.
Liberalism and liberal democracy are about sacred _processes_ , and legitimate _means_ , that constrain the pursuit of even just and noble ends.
That includes the end of defeating Trump.
If we took liberal democracy seriously -- if we believed in the sacred, God-given right of every American to make up their own mind and vote their conscience -- we would say, yes, there are many falsehoods on the internet and a demagogue running for president, but we trust the American people to sift through all of the information and decide. And if we disagree with that decision because it is conservative, rather than progressive, _that 's OK_. We respect it.
**Because if you take democracy seriously, you respect voters. Period.**_**Especially**_**when you don 't like them, or don't agree with their political opinions.**
**At bottom, the issue plaguing the Democratic party is elitism and a lack of respect.**
If Democrats truly respected voters, we would not, [like former CNN anchor Don Lemon](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/320d7e91-2803-4692-ad8f-b1cb474c3649?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), tell people who are struggling financially that they are, in fact, doing fine.
Barack Obama - formerly graceful and charming - is becoming a scold in the era of Trump. This week he [told young black men](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e966ebc2-8b04-49c7-b085-2e63a847ed2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that if they don't vote for Kamala, it's not because they prefer Trump's policies, it's because they are misogynists and bigots.
No one likes to be talked down to.
So you don't have to be a political genius to notice the current strategy will not work...
**V.**
I get that many of Trump's opponents believe Trump will end democracy as we know it. And that those voting for him simply don't realize what they are voting for.
Even if that is true, which is far from clear to me, the solution is not to lose your shit and prosecute Trump, cancel primaries, and jettison the 1st amendment. All of that makes Democrats look bad and has only empowered Trump. And it is wrong.
The only solution is to make your best case, campaign hard, and then, _surrender_.
_Let go_.
Trust in the common sense of our fellow Americans in Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Nevada, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina. Let them make a decision. And respect that decision -- even if you vehemently disagree with it.
If Democrats are unable extend that respect to everyday Americans -- who may be less formally 'educated' than we are, or disagree with our values -- we are no less a threat to democracy than the guy who won't concede.

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg9pmagmgn9lrjobsolag7215s44286hv65sg210_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0stj62pb4cdh2bs) [NO](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z80ogo5g5vuh734b3io3ikkhv9rboqpoinhh2a58_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0stj62pb4cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zm5tus63rpgrlmdem67gs9mikknljseijht6uqlo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0stj62pb4cdh2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. body:

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241012-1-900&t=2&akid=2051%2E135344%2Ekj_qGP)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails ahead of our final FEC fundraising deadline, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign as we're now in the final sprint. Do it before our FEC deadline ends.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241012-1-900&t=3&akid=2051%2E135344%2Ekj_qGP)**

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: A Win for School Choice – but Opponents of Parent Power Remain Strong
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msla-11573211?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **Local mom, Amanda Kibble, is celebrating an important win for her family, and for school choice!**

Earlier this year, Governor Tate Reeves signed HB 1341 into law. **This new law gives military families in Mississippi the right to transfer their children to any traditional public school around the state, assuming that the receiving school has capacity. **Early indications suggest this is extremely popular, with lots of military families using school choice to switch schools.
---
|
---
_Local Mom, Amanda Kibble, with Douglas Carswell._
| Amanda, and her family, found out the hard way that the law might not apply to those who serve their country in the National Guard. **There was a real risk that Amanda’s son might lose his place at his preferred school.**

**That’s when Amanda approached MCPP, and we took up her case.** MCPP has a long history of fighting for school choice, and our legal arm, the Mississippi Justice Institute has successfully litigated in defense of school choice.

**I am delighted that Attorney General, Lynn Fitch, has now issued an opinion that the new school choice law for military families also applies, at least in part, to those in the National Guard.** Three cheers for the AG!
---
|
---
_Lynn Fitch, Jason White, Michael Watson, Shad White: Conservatives support school choice!_
| **If military families now have public-to-public school choice, why shouldn’t everybody?** That is exactly what our **_[Move Up, Mississippi](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=295bc33c6c&e=5703353baa) _**campaign aims to achieve.

**This week’s win for school choice makes it all the more disappointing that the new State Superintendent for Education, Lance Evans, took a sideswipe at school choice in front of the press on Monday.**

Speaking at a lunch in Jackson, Evans criticized school choice, suggesting that if a single dollar of public money went into private schools, those private schools should be subjected to the regulatory oversight that public schools are subject to.
---
|
---
_Lance Evans, on the left, attacked school choice this week. Donald Trump supported school choice this week._
| **Those that oppose school choice, and indeed I suspect Mr Evans, know full well that extending state oversight across the private school sector would be untenable – which is why they suggest it.** But it is not the clever argument against school choice that they might imagine.

Giving every family in our state the right to choose a public school, as military families are now able to do, would not transfer public dollars into private schools.

**Amanda Kibble and those military families that now have school choice are not taking money out of public schools.** Does Lance Evans oppose their right to choose a school for their child?

MCPP proposes that under a separate program, families that attend private schools, or who home school, could get a tax credit reflecting the fact that they are already paying for a place at a public school that they are not taking.

**Evans attack on parent power was not the worst of it. More disappointing was the plodding presentation that preceded it about how amazing education is in our state. **

Evans trumpeted the fact that about a third of districts were rated D or F in 2016. Now only a handful are rated D or F. This, he implied, was evidence of progress, rather than a reflection of a broken accountability system.

When officials invoke the broken grading system as evidence of improvement, it is not just the credibility to the grading we should question.

**How bizarre, that in a solidly Republican-run state, we have somehow ended up with an anti-school choice official in charge?** Are the nine-member State Board of Education aware of Evans anti school choice position? Are the various state leaders that appointed those members of the Board?

Here is some data that Mr. Evans might have presented instead. **Over the past two decades, we have had an explosion in the number of administrative staff in education.** Think of all the fat cat education bureaucrats in Mississippi who earn more than our Governor ...

**The number of students has hardly changed.**
---
|
---
_Parent Power Is the Solution to the Bloated Bureaucrats_
| No wonder the education bureaucrats don’t want mom and dad to have control over where their child’s share of the education budget goes. They might start to demand that it goes into the classroom.

**Lance Evans talked about making private schools accountable. Private schools already are accountable to every fee paying parent.** The issue is how to ensure that public schools are made similarly accountable, too.

**We need to give every family in our state the public-to-public school choice that military families now have.**

Have a wonderful weekend!
---

---

---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell

Donald Trump supported school choice this week. | Those that oppose school choice, and indeed I suspect Mr Evans, know full well that extending state oversight across the private school sector would be untenable – which is why they suggest it. But it is not the clever argument against school choice that they might imagine. Giving every family in our state the right to choose a public school, as military families are now able to do, would not transfer public dollars into private schools. Amanda Kibble and those military families that now have school choice are not taking money out of public schools. Does Lance Evans oppose their right to choose a school for their child? MCPP proposes that under a separate program, families that attend private schools, or who home school, could get a tax credit reflecting the fact that they are already paying for a place at a public school that they are not taking. Evans attack on parent power was not the worst of it. More disappointing was the plodding presentation that preceded it about how amazing education is in our state. Evans trumpeted the fact that about a third of districts were rated D or F in 2016. Now only a handful are rated D or F. This, he implied, was evidence of progress, rather than a reflection of a broken accountability system. When officials invoke the broken grading system as evidence of improvement, it is not just the credibility to the grading we should question. How bizarre, that in a solidly Republican-run state, we have somehow ended up with an anti-school choice official in charge? Are the nine-member State Board of Education aware of Evans anti school choice position? Are the various state leaders that appointed those members of the Board? Here is some data that Mr. Evans might have presented instead. Over the past two decades, we have had an explosion in the number of administrative staff in education. Think of all the fat cat education bureaucrats in Mississippi who earn more than our Governor ... The number of students has hardly changed. | Parent Power Is the Solution to the Bloated Bureaucrats | No wonder the education bureaucrats don’t want mom and dad to have control over where their child’s share of the education budget goes. They might start to demand that it goes into the classroom. Lance Evans talked about making private schools accountable. Private schools already are accountable to every fee paying parent. The issue is how to ensure that public schools are made similarly accountable, too. We need to give every family in our state the public-to-public school choice that military families now have. Have a wonderful weekend! | "Forward this email to a friend!" | | Warm regards, Douglas Carswell President & CEO | | |

Fellow American - we are less than one month from Election Day, _and many of our top races that we need to flip are labeled as**toss-ups.**_

We are running out of time, **and everything is at stake.**
