body:
This is why I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
I was inspired by the community I grew up in to run for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. **Please let me tell you why:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/76208?refcode=em20241012-8046&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8046%2E614464%2E3N3ETv)
I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri. It was one of those places where the curbs crumbled into the streets and the sidewalks were so tilted you couldn’t really walk on them — though they made a pretty good bike ramp for all of us kids.
We all ran in and out of each other’s houses, everyone’s parents took care of everyone. **It was a magical place to live.**
Like so many families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck — and when my littlest sister was born with a heart condition, we were bankrupted by medical bills.
Our family got by thanks to the generosity of our community — most people had no more money than we did, but helped us anyway. Our neighbors and friends took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, they brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
Their support helped me go to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything our community did for me and my family growing up.
But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, I found that old magical place picked for parts — our local corner store was boarded up, our family’s first home in the neighborhood was bulldozed to the ground.
**Now it’s an empty lot:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/76208?refcode=em20241012-8046&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8046%2E614464%2E3N3ETv)
While all of us were risking our lives to build up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and corporate elites like Josh Hawley let our towns and neighborhoods at home waste away. And then, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, they couldn’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into our own country.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate because it’s time everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other, like the ones in my old neighborhood — called the shots in this country.[And today, I’m asking for your support to help me make it happen.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/76208?refcode=em20241012-8046&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8046%2E614464%2E3N3ETv)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/76208?refcode=em20241012-8046&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8046%2E614464%2E3N3ETv)
**If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve waged economic warfare on our country, I need you on November 5th, Peter.[Will you add a $10 donation to my campaign right now so we have the resources to fight back against Josh Hawley’s attacks, keep airing our own positive message, and flip this U.S. Senate seat in just 24 days? I don’t take any money from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/76208?refcode=em20241012-8046&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=8046%2E614464%2E3N3ETv)**

Lucas Kunce

And what if we told you that with Arizona heading out to the polls, our fundraising has completely dried up? We’re not raising what we need to fight back and defeat Trump and Lake in the home stretch.

## "In her final hours, Amber Nicole Thurman suffered from a grave infection that her suburban Atlanta hospital was well-equipped to treat."
## **"**_Thurman waited in pain in a hospital bed, worried about what would happen to her 6-year-old son_ , as doctors monitored her infection spreading, her blood pressure sinking and her organs beginning to fail."
## "It took 20 hours for doctors to finally operate. By then, **_it was too late_.**"
Amber's death in August 2022 has been declared the first official death from an abortion ban. But hers is far from the only one – we've all read and heard the stories of women turned away from emergency rooms bleeding from miscarriages, patients forced to carry nonviable pregnancies until they're sick enough for doctors to terminate, 13-year-olds forced to carry their rapist's baby because the closest clinic is hundreds of miles away in another state. This is the hell women and girls are living under because of Donald Trump and Brian Fitzpatrick's abortion bans. And it's killing us. Amber Nicole Thurman should be alive today. And she isn’t because politicians like Trump and Fitzpatrick think they know better than women and our doctors. Amber’s blood – and the trauma of every woman and girl living under an abortion ban – is on their hands. When I joined the Army at 17, I knew I would be risking my life in combat to protect our freedoms. I never imagined I would have to protect them from politicians right here at home, too. But when I saw Fitzpatrick vote over and over again to restrict our reproductive freedoms, I knew my mission remained the same, it was just the location that changed. I got into this race to protect our freedoms in the halls of Congress, just like I did on the battlefield. **I'm running for Amber and Amanda Zurawski and Kaitlyn Joshua and Kate Cox and a 13-year-old girl in Mississippi also named Ashley. They deserve better. And so do you, my fellow patriot.** Thanks for being in this fight with me as my co-pilot, Ashley 🚁

Madison’s decision to run for office was born out of deep frustration with the conduct of current politicians, the continued polarization of our country, and the lack of qualified individuals with technological expertise in Congress. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jeremy Shaffer
body:

| | | | | Dear ,
Only 24 days remain until November 5th! We’re in full swing knocking doors, sign waving, and meeting voters in every corner of the 28th District. On the ground we are gaining more positive momentum everyday. That said, on the airwaves, unfortunately, our community is being bombarded by a wave of negative—and completely false—mailers and TV ads against us.

We remain steadfast with our positive message to improve the lives of people and families in our region. Check out our new ad below!
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=a54816acf8&e=8c80cba7e7)
[KEEP OUR AD ON THE AIR]()
| Elections have real consequences, as we’re witnessing in Allegheny County. Just last year, Sara Innamorato won the race for Allegheny County Executive by a mere 1% over Joe Rockey, who is now endorsing our campaign. Now, Sara has proposed a staggering 46.5% property tax increase, which would be disastrous for our county and region. This will drive away even more residents and businesses, particularly impacting our seniors and working families. In Harrisburg, I will advocate for policies that promote growth, not destruction. I need your support to win in just over three weeks and to lead that fight.
**We Need Your Help with Door Knocking!**
Join us in our final push to spread our message! We have two door knocking events this weekend. We’ll meet at the GOP office (120 Church Rd, Wexford, PA 15090) for as long as you can contribute:
* **Saturday (10/12) at 12 PM**
* **Sunday (10/13) at 1 PM**

---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=dfdb75e33d&e=8c80cba7e7)
| **Volunteer Night – Saturday 10/12 at 6 PM**
Come help us seal, stuff, and stamp one of our final mailings! Join us at the GOP office (120 Church Rd, Wexford, PA 15090) anytime between 6 PM and 8:30 PM. Many hands make light work!
**Exciting Community Events!**
This Thursday, Stacey and I had the pleasure of supporting A.W. Beattie at the opening of their training restaurant for the school year. Beattie is a fantastic educational option for our community, serving nine school districts including Deer Lakes, Hampton, North Allegheny, and Pine-Richland. My youngest daughter and I also enjoyed the festival at the Depreciation Lands Museum, which highlights the rich history of our region. If you know of any upcoming events, please share!
---
| **Support Our Campaign**

I’m grateful to have the backing of former PA State House Speaker Mike Turzai, who represented the 28th District with distinction. He’s hosting a fundraiser for our campaign on October 21st. If you’re able, please consider supporting us.
---
| Thank you for your commitment and support!
With Gratitude,

Recent polls say that immigration is one of the key issues driving young voters to the polls so I wanted to share my own immigrant story and urge you to [tell Congress to pass the American Dream and Promise Act.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94874115/504830595/1641858054?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjQwZDYwYS1hNjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5X3IHx3ogJjNC_XhSm3a-btHNcaTM5w7xP2cqWwzsvs=&emci=90692caa-a488-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=7f40d60a-a688-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=6787172)
When I ask friends about their earliest memories, I hear a lot of sweet stories about playing childhood games and their family traditions.
**My first memory was crossing the border.**
I was just three years old and didn’t understand what was happening. But from the moment I entered this country, I carried a title that followed and tried to limit me in every way possible: **Undocumented.**
That title, and the stigma that comes with it, taught me a hard lesson. While this country claims to be the land of opportunity and justice for all, that promise is conditional and subject to change.
**Still, despite that lesson, loving America is all I’ve ever known.**
When President Obama introduced the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program, I jumped at the chance to finally experience what it’s like to have this country recognize my humanity. Thanks to DACA, I was able to get a driver’s license and Social Security card, go to college, and get a job.
But DACA was a temporary fix, not a permanent solution. **And the process of qualifying for it is traumatic.**
Every two years, thousands of DACA recipients undergo the humiliating process of being evaluated by United States Citizenship and Immigration Services to prove that they belong here. Their fingerprints and mugshot taken as if they were being booked into jail. And still, after all that, work permits aren't a guarantee. The only thing that's certain is that dreamers live a life in limbo, at the mercy of politicians who at times only seem to care about fanning the flames of hate and discrimination.
I don’t tell you all this to make you feel sorry for me. I’m telling you this because I’ve been fighting for a decade to make sure people like me get the legal protection they deserve. **And I refuse to be quiet while politicians bargain with our futures.**
[I’m determined to fight to make the promise of the American dream a reality for other Dreamers. And I’m asking you to stand with me. Will you write to your elected officials today and demand that we provide a pathway to citizenship for DACA recipients?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94874116/504830596/75774113?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjQwZDYwYS1hNjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5X3IHx3ogJjNC_XhSm3a-btHNcaTM5w7xP2cqWwzsvs=&emci=90692caa-a488-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=7f40d60a-a688-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=6787172)

| [ ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc44634e8f9d484a929379ea76563f65&_e=jGD9mUxcs881a-kerpdBBeDSO9IpGIh3g1qWJfZuROFx4Az6hJWjrCQlCI1WY_p-O836hQer0JSMEimn6LYAD1-wIv54QYSj8Vl7X65FDsUu8zZDo7hbK_2KF1CRJpcRuysT5fvXtUq7IkDDw1-ayDTmod0IVWrglc0msXSoJ1Lsihs52_JDiLsxlIG22qC3tSXWGEd45h5LpCvbEo6_5xtZgtY7h7zEozpHab_JT_uqDgI1Heiizko7WCURJ81-tDKtkGNpn5tokUdNY3LESaWW0UoYdxc3peYTjKt8-OY1XanjBBuxGtMcScX7k-CGAzhQkV4Ta8KfIifxz7fmVw%3D%3D)

Fellow American,

In 2012, I was drafted into the NBA--it was a dream come true until I decided to stand up for what I believed in. I've struggled with mental health my entire life, and severe anxiety has been a demon following me at every turn in life. Mental health carried more of a stigma back then; it was hard to open up and take a stand, especially as a first-year player in the NBA. _But, that didn 't stop me from risking everything for something I believed in._

**My story is ultimately one of healing, perseverance, and redemption.**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc44634e8f9d484a929379ea76563f65&_e=jGD9mUxcs881a-kerpdBBeDSO9IpGIh3g1qWJfZuROFx4Az6hJWjrCQlCI1WY_p-O836hQer0JSMEimn6LYAD1-wIv54QYSj8Vl7X65FDsUu8zZDo7hbK_2KF1CRJpcRuysT5fvXtUq7IkDDw1-ayDTmod0IVWrglc0msXSoJ1Lsihs52_JDiLsxlIG22qC31cWDFinmRpnjm4tke3g18WuJxOCSG8OrcyWR7LJwATD3i6As_apFfzvFMZHgEk1aGe4f6C7qbV80Z47JszMUeURV_AkIobBXgcgPdka9BLXH8X7S-vmWApxyitpMwXe6lTf7iCXUfh2TTSJrJEp0Ng%3D%3D)
At the time, the NBA didn't have any policies to support players' mental health. A grueling 82-game season will weigh on anyone--the best athletes in the world included. As someone who has dealt with an extreme level of anxiety growing up, being thrust onto one of the biggest stages in the world at 21 years old was challenging, to say the least. That's why I decided to speak out and open a dialogue with the NBA about mental health. It was a huge risk at the time, but one that I believed was worth it. I hoped I could help other players who were struggling get the resources they needed.

I did. Despite my speaking out resulting in a huge divide between myself and the NBA, causing me to give up my childhood dream and move over to Canada's professional basketball league, I still think it was worth it. **If I had to, I would do it all again, no questions asked. Now, the NBA has a policy for players ' mental health, and I like to think that I started the conversation to make that happen.**

Throughout the process, my name was dragged through the mud by the Industrial Media Complex. As I said, in 2012, there was a much different stigma about mental health than there is today. But I put my name, my career, and my life on the line to stand up for myself and other players who kept silent because it was bigger than basketball.

**_Today, I have a simple message for anyone struggling with mental health, including our troops, veterans, children, and all Americans: there 's no shame in asking for help, and there's no shame in standing up for yourself. If I could do it, so can you._**

But now that I'm running for Senate, my story is resurfacing, and I'm being attacked by the Radical Left. This race is one of the most important Senate races in 2024, but the mainstream media won't take me seriously. [**Day in and day out, I 'm told that I don't have a chance to win in Minnesota.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc44634e8f9d484a929379ea76563f65&_e=jGD9mUxcs881a-kerpdBBeDSO9IpGIh3g1qWJfZuROFx4Az6hJWjrCQlCI1WY_p-O836hQer0JSMEimn6LYAD1-wIv54QYSj8Vl7X65FDsUu8zZDo7hbK_2KF1CRJpcRuysT5fvXtUq7IkDDw1-ayDTmod0IVWrglc0msXSoJ1Lsihs52_JDiLsxlIG22qC33wl_jvuArwx0ZfFXqobx9VHDhhHkZqvAqSjNF0razGzNiV51yrvVW5BhbFzgFQYmYjCC7N_-BIPML5me18dEensquv8oRNHnEZLJLZ-HftS9M8IVhGgsEB3eE5s_kwdSvkPg9I2Nyk6SWfL0UVE2mg%3D%3D)

**Just like when I fought and won in 2012, I will fight and win in 2024.**
Democrats are spending MILLIONS of dollars protecting my Radical Opponent, Amy Klobuchar. Every hour that Democrats attack me and suppress my voice in the media without my campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, I'm at a huge disadvantage.

[**I need your help combating their tasteless attacks against me and spreading my message to important fringe voters. Will you please donate to my media fund by midnight?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc44634e8f9d484a929379ea76563f65&_e=jGD9mUxcs881a-kerpdBBeDSO9IpGIh3g1qWJfZuROFx4Az6hJWjrCQlCI1WY_p-O836hQer0JSMEimn6LYAD1-wIv54QYSj8Vl7X65FDsUu8zZDo7hbK_2KF1CRJpcRuysT5fvXtUq7IkDDw1-ayDTmod0IVWrglc0msXSoJ1Lsihs52_JDiLsxlIG22qC3U_bxPwmY8xe_ipIm3mrd2Qw4Sj5HB71SXzPgtzyWJvdiy5XJtWYCCmhBIKh17P-FryhJPZoSzChaN3K_75fwXBmwFj5NpRl0iN6WqSyUDLZ9xtpb4rzU4wxi7jOhqhKkHVzRkCxU7vaBkbXMIkA3wA%3D%3D)
| [ **RUSH YOUR SUPPORT** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc44634e8f9d484a929379ea76563f65&_e=jGD9mUxcs881a-kerpdBBeDSO9IpGIh3g1qWJfZuROFx4Az6hJWjrCQlCI1WY_p-O836hQer0JSMEimn6LYAD1-wIv54QYSj8Vl7X65FDsUu8zZDo7hbK_2KF1CRJpcRuysT5fvXtUq7IkDDw1-ayDTmod0IVWrglc0msXSoJ1Lsihs52_JDiLsxlIG22qC3Syw2QcQarydbDIsi2isZjW9l-sh9mIu-gMMy7WWS96u5iRV4GBPTPW1ww_2tbSchq6LHztZM3N9b3BODEIxcnBr7MQbk98n2vYpE1lE82l-tI6IDZVenpIqIanrFW0rB8WHes8FGfwEDjXEp3h4SkQ%3D%3D)

body:
#

Growing up, this little guy learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241012-1-120&t=1&akid=5896%2E6688874%2Edb-FKh)
At the age of 23, he became a United States naval aviator. He deployed twice on the U.S.S. Midway and flew 39 combat missions in Operation Desert Storm.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241012-1-120&t=2&akid=5896%2E6688874%2Edb-FKh)
Then, at the age of 32, he was selected as an astronaut (with his twin brother, Scott!). He flew his first of four missions into space in 2001 aboard Space Shuttle Endeavour. He spent more than 50 days in space and has lived on the International Space Station.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241012-1-120&t=3&akid=5896%2E6688874%2Edb-FKh)
In 2011, Mark's wife, Former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, was shot in Tucson during an event where she was meeting with her constituents. Mark retired from the Navy and NASA, and his mission turned from service to his country to caring for his wife. But Gabby's service in Congress, using policy to improve people's lives, stuck with him.
So, in 2019, Mark took on his next mission — running for U.S. Senate in Arizona — and won. Since he was sworn in, Mark has been focused every day on making Washington work for all Arizonans. And in 2022, he won again, earning a full term in the Senate.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241012-1-120&t=4&akid=5896%2E6688874%2Edb-FKh)
Now, this campaign is looking towards the crucial election coming up in just a few weeks. Arizona will be one of the most closely contested states in the country, and we’re working to beat Trump and support pro-democracy candidates up and down the ballot.
So please:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution today and power our efforts in Arizona? Help us continue to build this grassroots team and win once again.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241012-1-120&t=5&akid=5896%2E6688874%2Edb-FKh)
**[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&amount=3&refcode=em241012-1-120&t=6&akid=5896%2E6688874%2Edb-FKh)**
Thank you for taking the time to read our message today.
Team Kelly

Mark Kelly was a Captain in the U.S. Navy and astronaut. # The ballots are out!
---
|
The ballots are officially out, and the clock is ticking! With just 24 days remaining until Election Day, we have over 200,000 voters we need to remind to turn in their ballots. The most effective way to reach them quickly is through text messages—but we need your help to make sure we can reach every single one.
Here’s how your donation can make a difference:
* $50 will allow us to reach 1,400 voters with critical reminders to turn in their ballots.

* $100 will allow us to reach 2,800 voters and ensure they know their vote matters.

Every single dollar counts in this final stretch. Your contribution will directly help us get out the vote, and make sure no one forgets to cast their ballot.
Can we count on you to chip in $25, $50, or even $100 today? With so much on the line, this is our moment to push forward.
Together, we can get those ballots turned in and secure a victory for our community!
Thank you for your support.
In solidarity,
River Gassen
Candidate for U.S. Congress - Colorado District 5

#
**We can’t afford even the smallest slowdown in our fundraising.**
→ _Not_ when there are less than 25 days left in this election.
→ _Not_ when we’ll be running TV ads in one of the most expensive media markets in the country.
→ _Not_ when Sarah’s up against a pro-Project 2025 Republican opponent, and MAGA extremists are keeping a close eye on our race.

**But after a big surge in grassroots support in September, we started October with a massive slowdown.** Here’s a screenshot of our fundraising:

But we also need a steady stream of grassroots donations to pay for ads, organizers, and our final get-out-the-vote efforts.
[**If you can, please make a contribution today!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241012-1?refcode=em20241012-1-1372&refcode2=1372_21716_732OxA&akid=1372%2E21716%2E732OxA)

subject: Why today?

body:
Republicans have engaged in an all out ad blitz to flip my seat red. Eric Hovde and the dark money super PACs supporting him have poured tens of millions of dollars into this race to defeat me.

| Hi Peter — If it’s anything like mine, I can only assume your inbox is full of requests from campaigns like mine trying to earn your support.

And I’m guessing you didn’t wake up today thinking, _“today’s the day I’m going to donate to Tammy’s reelection campaign!”_ But I hope you’ll give me a chance to make the case.

**Republicans have engaged in an all out ad blitz to flip my seat red.** Eric Hovde and the dark money super PACs supporting him have poured tens of millions of dollars into this race to defeat me.

If they flip Wisconsin red, they’ll take back our Senate majority. And then, a national abortion ban, cuts to Social Security and Medicare, a repeal of the Affordable Care Act, and so much more will be on the table.

Wisconsin is shaping up to be THE tipping point state that will decide control of the Senate, and our race has quickly become one of the most expensive and competitive in the country.

As poll after poll shows a statistically tied race, it’s urgent that we fight back against the Republican attacks I’m facing with ads of our own to set the record straight.

But these ad reservations don’t come cheap, and I don’t have the same luxury of dipping into a personal fortune to fund this campaign like my megamillionaire opponent can. That’s why I’m counting on your grassroots support today.

**With the election swiftly approaching, if you are ready to make a difference and help us defend our Democratic Senate majority, now’s the time, Peter.**

subject: 💵Running for office ain’t cheap!

body:
Do you know what’s one of the toughest barriers young people face when running for office?
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241012&t=1&akid=1298%2E587540%2Ec-Swea)
Peter, do you know what’s one of the toughest barriers young people face when running for office?
_Money._
**We’ll explain more about how messed up that is in a minute — but if you’re short on time, know this:**
Leaders We Deserve invests in young people who are fighting for a progressive future. **[Will you pitch in to help our endorsed slate of progressive candidates with the tools, money, and grassroots network they need to win this November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241012?refcode=em20241012&amount=5&refcode2=1298_587540_c-Swea&akid=1298%2E587540%2Ec-Swea)**
Running a winning campaign isn’t cheap. From hiring staff to paying for TV ads, it can cost several thousand to _millions of dollars_ to run and win.
The reality is that most young people don’t have the personal resources to self-fund a campaign or a wealthy network of donors to tap into to help pay for campaign expenses.
Even the costs of running for local office are often too out of reach for young people — especially in states where state-level legislators get paid very little, or nothing at all, for their work. How is the average person, especially a younger person, supposed to take a job that costs money to get it, and pays nothing in return?
**Peter, young people are priced out of running for office.** It’s no wonder that despite making up 45% of the electorate, Gen Z and Millenials only hold 21% of State Legislature seats.
To build a truly representative democracy and bring about generational change to all levels of government, we need to invest in young candidates — and that’s exactly what we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve.
**Your contribution today will help us change the game, knock down barriers, and invest — and elect — young candidates this November.** **[Will you pitch in $5 to Leaders We Deserve?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241012?refcode=em20241012&amount=5&refcode2=1298_587540_c-Swea&akid=1298%2E587540%2Ec-Swea)**

We can’t do this without you!

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: It's all connected.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
A new Supreme Court term started this week.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2371%2E4032634%2Eg2xeCE)
---
A new Supreme Court term started this week. One of their first decisions was declining to hear a case that would require emergency rooms in Texas to provide an abortion if a pregnant patient’s health or life would be at serious risk if they don’t receive one. By refusing to hear this case, the extremists appointed to the Supreme Court by Donald Trump are allowing Texas to deny women abortion care — even in a medical emergency. Reminder: This is the same extremist Supreme Court stacked by Donald Trump that overturned _Roe v. Wade_. Reminder: This is the same extremist Supreme Court stacked by Donald Trump that ruled that the president is above the law, giving free rein to abuse the power of the presidency without constraint. Reminder: There’s a page in Project 2025 that says that if Donald Trump is president, he can install the right person at the Department of Justice to enforce a total national abortion ban, through an interpretation of an old law called the Comstock Act. It’s all connected. Trump and the far-right movement are plotting to take over and abuse our government institutions to attack our democracy and rip away our freedoms. And another reminder: The next president could nominate the next one, two, or three Supreme Court justices. That’s what’s at stake in this election. **Here’s what we can do about this:** In the short-term, we must prevent Donald Trump from returning to the White House and therefore prevent Project 2025 from being enacted. That must be our top priority. Period. We also need to hold our Senate majority to pass national abortion protections and keep the GOP from getting veto power over new Supreme Court justice nominations. Congress must also make Supreme Court justices finally follow a basic and enforceable code of ethics and give Americans confidence that their judges are held to the highest standards and are free from conflicts of interest. I’ve introduced legislation to do just that. After that, in the long-term, Congress must restore balance by adding more justices to the Court. Congress has already used its constitutional authority to change the size of the Supreme Court seven times in the past. This isn’t new. It’s what we must do to rebalance a Court that Republicans packed and that clearly doesn’t feel limited by the rule of law. And we also need to end the filibuster. It’s a relic of the Jim Crow-era that is found nowhere in the Constitution and has blocked policies that are so overwhelmingly popular among voters — voters who voted for a Democratic majority — because a minority of Republican senators disagree. This will allow us to pass the policies that the majority of Americans are calling for, like federal abortion rights, voting protections, and gun safety laws. This is all within our reach. But a Trump dictatorship is within reach, too. That’s what is at stake this year. These attacks on our rights, institutions, and democracy are meant to exhaust us. Meant to drain us of our will to fight. But we can’t let them succeed. When we identify the problems we face as a nation, lay out solutions, and go out and fight for them, we can win. I’m throwing everything I’ve got into this fight. That’s my plan from now through November and beyond. And I’m asking you to stay by my side. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

---
In the fallout of Florida's ill-prepared and executed response to Hurricane Milton, DeSantis has (per usual) gone on the offensive about why the state has no obligation to regulate industries that pose a threat to human health and safety -- even during major hurricane preparations.
Most states prone to hurricanes have [strict laws regarding vessel](https://substack.com/redirect/67c7d2d5-2672-46e4-9389-080f16317f36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and industrial safety during storms.
But Ron DeSantis wants Florida to maintain its reputation for being perpetually irresponsible, saying to one reporter when asked about securing cranes and other dangerous machinery prior to hurricane landfall: "[Do we have to regulate everything?](https://substack.com/redirect/3c993e31-5832-4a4f-802e-9f8cae50a8ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"'
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a64f3a75-6f2a-4b8e-be65-f386d4a033e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
DeSantis' refusals to regulate [climate change](https://substack.com/redirect/5ad8433a-e754-44a1-ac06-71151dbc053b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [home insurance](https://substack.com/redirect/2072666c-461f-4443-a2b0-38b2b0eb5c4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) aside, here's a non-comprehensive list of issues DeSantis thought was _important_ to regulate:
##### LAB GROWN MEAT
[https://www.tallahassee.com/story/news/politics/2024/05/01/gov-ron-desantis-signs-lab-grown-meat-ban-in-florida/73525706007/](https://substack.com/redirect/29731c6e-684d-4662-a607-099011e220d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
##### ANYTHING GAY
[https://www.npr.org/2022/03/28/1089221657/dont-say-gay-florida-desantis](https://substack.com/redirect/fe95806c-67d7-437d-b6b4-cd19d368a06c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
##### RAINBOW LIGHTS
[https://www.them.us/story/florida-bridges-rainbow-pride-month-ron-desantis](https://substack.com/redirect/1e18694b-9b96-43a5-ad3d-ef2f147c5f27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
##### THE WORDS "CLIMATE CHANGE"
[https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/2024/05/15/florida-law-climate-change-desantis-energy/](https://substack.com/redirect/5ad8433a-e754-44a1-ac06-71151dbc053b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
##### WOMEN'S RIGHTS
[https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/desantis-signs-bill-banning-abortion-in-florida-after-6-weeks-of-pregnancy](https://substack.com/redirect/52be96cc-b5ba-4b9f-b78c-039d9e3bfa5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
_By Jess Bigood, NYT_ It was 7:15 a.m. on Sunday, and a blood-orange sun had turned the sky lavender. Dr. Kristin Lyerly was getting ready to leave.

She had laundry going, and her bags half-packed. She felt as if she might be forgetting something. She was about to make the 400-mile drive from her home in De Pere, Wis., for a 10-day stint at a medical center in Hibbing, Minn., where she has been working as an obstetrician-gynecologist following the overturning of _Roe v. Wade._

Lyerly has another job, too: running for Congress.

Abortion rights have become central to the fight for control of the White House and Congress, and Democrats have worked hard to bring the issue to life through the stories of women who have had abortions. Lyerly, though, is doing something a little rarer: campaigning as a Democrat who can talk about providing reproductive care in post-Roe America.

She said she had bumped into children she delivered on the trail. She has been approached by women at campaign events seeking basic information about handling an unwanted pregnancy or a miscarriage. She hasn’t heeded the advice that she said she got from men suggesting she talk about the issue a little bit less.

“Reproductive rights,” she told a group of teachers who gathered to knock on doors in Green Bay, Wis., last weekend, “are on everybody’s mind.”

Lyerly’s district, Wisconsin’s Eighth, encompasses a rural swath of the northeastern part of the state, the city of Green Bay and the peninsula that looks like the state’s pinkie finger dipping into Lake Michigan. It is difficult territory for Democrats. Former Representative Mike Gallagher, a Republican who chafed at Trump’s influence over his party, held it easily for seven years before suddenly retiring in April; a Trump-endorsed former gas station chain owner, Tony Wied, is favored to win the seat.

Lyerly, though, is betting that running on reproductive rights can help Democrats make inroads even here, in a culturally conservative and heavily Catholic part of the state. And as part of the recent explosion of Democratic activism in the state that my colleague Jonathan Weisman wrote about this morning, she has helped to recruit a cohort of down-ballot candidates in the area who share that belief.

“Women deserve better. We’re not just machines. You can’t just change out a part,” she told me in an interview. “We are human beings, and it’s not just us who go through these things — it’s the people in our lives, our partners and our kids and the people who love us.”
**‘We have to talk about it’** There are two members of Congress who have worked as OB-GYN doctors, Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas and Representative Michael Burgess of Texas. Both are Republican men who praised the 2022 Supreme Court ruling that overturned Roe.

Lyerly is one of two female OB-GYN doctors running to join them. The other, Kelly Morrison, a Democrat who is running in the suburban Minnesota district currently represented by the retiring Democrat Dean Phillips, is favored to win.

It was not very long ago that Lyerly, who is a mother of four, worried that her background — which includes a stint working as an assistant in an abortion clinic early in her career — could be a political liability. When she ran unsuccessfully for the State Assembly in 2020, she said, she didn’t talk about it at all.

Lyerly went to work at a Planned Parenthood clinic in Sheboygan, Wis., in early 2022, and watched as abortions were outlawed in the state in an instant.

“I threw caution to the wind, and said, ‘We have to talk about it,’” Lyerly said.

She joined a lawsuit challenging the state’s 1849 abortion ban and began practicing in Minnesota. Planned Parenthood has since resumed providing abortions in Wisconsin, but she has continued to work out of state.

“I’ve had patients arrive bleeding — wanted pregnancy — prior to 24 weeks, right in that 22-24 week span,” Lyerly said. “In Wisconsin, I would be wondering, ‘If I do her abortion to save her life, am I going to get in trouble? Am I going to lose my license?’ In Minnesota, I didn’t have to think twice about it.”

Another political transformation was happening in Wisconsin: After liberals secured a majority on the State Supreme Court last year, the State Assembly’s heavily gerrymandered maps were thrown out. Lyerly and other local Democrats worked to find candidates for every race they could — a group that included women and L.G.B.T.Q. candidates — and then Lyerly jumped into the congressional race in April.

“We are the gals, the gays and a few good men,” Lyerly said. “I do believe that it is a winning issue.”
**Hoping for a quiet majority** One of those gals is Christy Welch, a former manufacturing executive and first-time State Assembly candidate, who was pounding the pavement in a biting wind on Saturday as part of the door-knocking effort. I asked to accompany her because I was curious to hear how she — and the voters she spoke with — would talk about abortion rights.

At each door, Welch handed voters a piece of campaign literature and asked them which of the issues listed resonated most. A 19-year-old voter named Skye Mallori was quick to pick reproductive rights.

“That’s a big reason why I’m standing here right now,” Welch said, explaining that she had gotten involved in local Democratic politics after Roe fell.

“It’s really backward. It’s so cool that you’re doing this,” said Valeria Gallardo, 30, after Welch knocked on her door.

Welch did not, however, bring up reproductive rights unless a voter did first — reflecting a touch of caution that still characterizes Democrats’ approach to abortion here, even for Lyerly.

“It’s one of the most Catholic districts in the country,” said Lyerly, who added that she chose her words carefully. “We don’t talk about abortion because it’s too harsh of a word, but we do talk about reproductive rights.”

The candidates here have also become accustomed to finding voters who want to support them quietly. Lyerly said one woman had come to the local Democratic Party headquarters recently, asking if she could write the party a check without her husband finding out. There are sticky notes that voters can take to stick in bathrooms, urging women to vote for Lyerly or Vice President Kamala Harris.

“Woman to woman,” one note said, “your vote is private.”

Welch spoke on Saturday with a voter who told her that she planned to vote for her, Lyerly, and other Democrats up and down the ticket. She had grown up in a deeply conservative household, she said, and she didn’t like the idea of late-term abortions, but she planned to vote for candidates who supported a woman’s right to them.

“If anybody asked, I’m not so conservative this year, because they’re so far off the rails,” she told me. The voter initially told me her full name and said I could quote her. But about an hour after we spoke, she called to ask that I print only her first name, Emily, because she did not want to upset her conservative friends.

Voters like Emily are exactly who Lyerly and Welch are trying to reach.

#

We’ve all been there:
You’re enjoying a gathering with family or friends and suddenly, the conversation turns political. With just over three weeks left until Election Day and many folks already casting ballots through early voting, these conversations may be coming up more frequently than usual for you.
Instead of squirming in your chair when your relative brings up guns or voting for Trump, you should feel empowered to say something. After all, we know the most effective messengers are the people around us. That means YOU have the ability to change the hearts and minds of the people you care about.
**If it comes up in conversation, you can say with confidence that another four years of Donald Trump would be a major setback to the fight to save lives from gun violence. Here are some of the facts:**
* According to FBI data, from 2022 to 2023 our country had the largest decline in murders in decades under President Biden’s leadership. During Trump’s time as president, homicides rose by over 30 percent.

* Nearly 44,000 people die from gun violence every year in the U.S. and gun violence is the number one cause of death for children in our country. Yet at an NRA event earlier this year, Trump bragged that his administration “did nothing” on guns.

* Assault weapons were used in seven of the deadliest mass shootings between the years of 2010 to 2020. Meanwhile, extreme members of the House and Senate won’t allow an assault weapons ban to come to the floor for a vote.

* About 90% of Americans support background checks for all gun sales. Background checks are just common sense, and help keep guns out of the hands of people with the intent to harm others.

* The Biden-Harris administration has been the most pro-gun safety administration we've ever had. President Biden signed the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ into law—the most significant federal gun safety legislation passed in nearly 30 years. Among many historic actions, this legislation expanded background checks and provided schools and communities with funding for mental health resources and community violence intervention programs. We can be sure Vice President Kamala Harris will continue to build on this progress as our next president.

Friends, don’t be afraid to use your voice. This November’s elections are the most important ones of our lifetimes. Help the people you care about stay informed about the American gun violence crisis, and let them know that the **_only**_ presidential candidate who will keep our communities safe from gun violence is Vice President Kamala Harris.
\- The team at GIFFORDS
* * *

**👋 Hey there, before you go...**

If everyone reading this donated just $20, we'd have the resources to take on the gun lobby and elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot this November. But not everyone gives -- that makes it even more important for people who care and understand the stakes of our struggle to chip in what they can.

If $20 seems worth it to you to change our gun laws in order to make our communities safer from gun violence, we're asking you to [**contribute to GIFFORDS PAC today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241012-1-60&t=1&akid=9179%2E3935704%2E9ZxY5L)

clean_body: | | | Peter, we are writing to ask if you can make a well-timed contribution to Kamala Harris's campaign for president. But before we do, you deserve to know how we'll put your donation to work to win this election. Every campaign starts with something called a "win number." That is the number of votes we think we need to reach to win each state. There are Democrats we know vote in almost every election, and we can count on their votes. But then, there are the Democrats who don't vote all the time -- and the persuadable voters. That’s where elections are won or lost. It takes resources to reach those voters. Sometimes it's with ads. Sometimes it's with organizers doing individual outreach. And then, it requires even more resources to make sure our voters actually vote. When you think about how small the margins are in some of the battleground states, you can see why focusing on these voters is so critically important. That is how we use the $5, $10, and $25 contributions we receive. [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-welcomes-his-majesty-king-abdullah-ii-of-jordan-to-annapolis-for-historic-state-house-visit.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/v6oan58rw6TfHsaUmUqfHyRetle2MF1jC3kPOflD1oM=374)
| My Fellow Marylanders, We have had another incredible last few weeks, starting off with the First Lady and I welcoming His Majesty King Abdullah II of Jordan to Annapolis. His Majesty’s presence marks the first time a foreign head of state has visited the Maryland State House on official business. During our roundtable discussion with leaders from both Maryland higher education institutions and our private sector, we discussed trade, investment, and partnership opportunities between Maryland and Jordan. Following His Majesty’s visit, I traveled to [Allegany County](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-visits-cumberland-to-tour-major-economic-development-investments.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/ydqA6I0h7R95bJzfFK3EIKT62k-ZQWs9x-zW5Fv3Y4s=374), [Charles County](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2FPages%2Fgovernor-moore-visits-charles-county-to-tour-indian-head-naval-base-oasis-fresh-food-market-and-mallows-bay.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/MKeY860i0FAlWqoGgEJOX3QJUFBD_FCMaH6GuAeGJOs=374), [Washington County](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-continues-statewide-cabinet-meeting-road-tour-in-washington-county.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/pxQAMSlsDgsDAvS7e8562ZVJdivyD83ph5Bk_9S1Lqc=374), and [Wicomico County](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2FPages%2Fgovernor-moore-visits-salisbury-to-tour-major-community-and-economic-development-projects.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/LReK59tM81DCcQjiM1L81ukoS-RxHgRtntpCKwBEaDQ=374) to see the major economic development projects being supported by state, local and federal investments, including the Baltimore Street redevelopment project, Canal Place River Park project, and Oasis Fresh Food Market. I also visited Baltimore to announce an executive order establishing [Reinvest Baltimore](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-signs-executive-order-to-maximize-economic-potential-for-neighborhoods-in-baltimore-city.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/b7ymIKboVKdJjD9KEhyzmL4nx9cZw8jRtGlgD0Yzyhs=374), a coordinated effort between the State of Maryland, Baltimore City, and nonprofit and for-profit partners to eliminate concentrations of vacant properties, revitalize neighborhoods, and maximize the economic potential and quality of life for residents. This Administration is deeply committed to working in partnership across all levels of government to create opportunities that uplift our businesses, neighborhoods, and local economies across the entirety of this great state – and we couldn’t do it without you. Your Governor,
Wes Moore [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2FPages%2Fhome.aspx/2/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/9gxXrO4f882N2-JiNm4dF4LLrEK6yZ1nvb8ry9YjXCg=374)

## **Helping Those Impacted by
Hurricanes Helene and Milton
**
[](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-announces-maryland-teams-aid-southern-states-impacted-by-storms.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/ZQ8SeqQnTZbrF7Dv1zHBVvIDd326fH8IdtNeS96-2LI=374)
In the face of disasters, [Maryland stands ready to help Americans in need.](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-announces-maryland-teams-aid-southern-states-impacted-by-storms.aspx/2/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/p7ijyS772bGlv7HcQGk5J0I8K9CQMQtW7TTCD9Fy6Ho=374) I'm proud that Marylanders, through the [Emergency Management Assistance Compact](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Flinks-1.govdelivery.com%2FCL0%2Fhttps:%252F%252Fwww.emacweb.org%252F%2F1%2F010001927859c67f-629c1461-f883-4c91-b0e8-3316a4df7fca-000000%2Fnrx8nMfbbGU8a870rcoPwG-C_R5KD3OiDJnwriT1lBE=374/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/CrNLBN-RIG02oXArRdk4RmkYOoZB-Fadte9bT-_pbX0=374), are aiding with the response and recovery efforts for our neighbors in the southeast United States in the wake of Hurricanes Helene and Milton. The First Lady and I pray for their safety and for the safety of everyone affected by these natural disasters.

and Veteran-Owned Business Growth

[](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-announces-dollar22-million-to-support-small-minority-and-veteran-owned-business-growth.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/uZcjtGJZ7cGBsNWYtWfKcmfP1Xt0uNAEJh0AzdnmUSg=374)
This week, we announced just over $2 million in financial assistance to [support small, minority, and veteran-owned business growth](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-announces-dollar22-million-to-support-small-minority-and-veteran-owned-business-growth.aspx/2/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/kZNziuhox4osfKHRpTZTBCV_v3-jw-MmJefDstVAiS8=374) to help make Maryland more competitive. To make Maryland more competitive, we need to uplift our entrepreneurs. That's why we are working together to ensure Maryland is the best state in the country to start, build, and grow a business. These state programs are uplifting entrepreneurs of all backgrounds, and building new pathways to work, wages, and wealth.

## Debt Cancellation for Mandatory, Parole and Administrative Release Supervision and
## Drug Testing Fees

Marylanders who serve their time deserve a second chance without bearing the financial burden of recurring administrative fees. That’s why, days ago, [I announced that the Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services will cancel the debt](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-announces-debt-cancellation-for-mandatory-parole-and-administrative-release-supervision-and-drug-testing-fee.aspx/1/01000192816b375a-4cc9e707-3d66-484a-aaa5-b0b3f497ed11-000000/2nbm5ckXjyyWz5qDjrVWMm7Ql9aSlc6Ga2K6moGCz0U=374) for outstanding mandatory, parole, and administrative release supervision fees and drug testing fees for individuals who are currently under the supervision of the agency’s Division of Parole and Probation. This action will help promote successful reintegration and reduce recidivism among returning citizens, as well as helping our state continue to create paths to work, wages, and wealth for Marylanders.

To: NDRC “Team Michigan”
Re: Updates from the ground Hi Peter, Here with a quick update on some important items I’m tracking from my home state of Michigan. **Holding the Michigan State House**
Republicans are trying to take back the State House and end the Democratic trifecta we helped win in 2022. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. There are extreme MAGA candidates on the ballot – like Representative Matt Maddock, who is running for reelection to the 51st district. Not only did Maddock perpetuate the lies about the 2020 election results, he was in DC on January 6th and spoke at a pro-Trump rally the night before. But we have endorsed some extraordinary House candidates as part of this year’s Democracy Defenders program — and they are ready to hold the line against extreme MAGA Republicans who are doing everything they can to maintain power and bring Project 2025 policies into our communities. These pro-democracy leaders need your help right now. [**Can you make a donation to help hold the House here in Michigan and defend democracy across the country?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94883381/504859302/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_TeamMichigan_email_20241012-NDRC-Tier1-TeamMichigan_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241012-NDRC-Tier1-TeamMichigan_&utm_campaign=TeamMichigan&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ2NzIyNDA1LWIzODgtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=uudoX4BNvpzbUkAQ7oPSYIIQQHmouix0Y4MHwt3WI-c=) **Protecting the State Supreme Court**
Progressive justices currently hold a 4-3 majority in the Michigan State Supreme Court — and there are two seats up this November. Unsurprisingly, Republicans have nominated two extreme candidates. One of them, Andrew Fink, perpetuates the “Big Lie” and actually attended a “Stop the Steal” rally at the Michigan State Capitol on January 6, 2021. The other candidate, Patrick William O’Grady, was recently endorsed by Donald Trump and is backed by “Right to Life Michigan,” an anti-abortion organization. There are two _phenomenal_ Democratic candidates who’ve stepped up to preserve our fundamental rights. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Look, big change starts small.
That's a lesson that my grandmother, Polly Noonan, first taught me decades ago. Well before most women had any political power, my grandmother organized women into a political force in Albany.
By the time I was in elementary school, I was tagging along with her to all kinds of Democratic campaign headquarters, rallies and events. She remains one of my biggest role models — and I carry her wisdom with me to this day. **She taught me that my voice matters, that women’s voices matter and that grassroots activism matters. And she showed me how campaigns are won by the people who put in the work like the volunteers knocking doors, stuffing envelopes, turning out the vote and donating what they can, when they can.**
For decades, first by my grandmother's side and then as a public servant myself, I've seen how those small grassroots actions all add up to victory on Election Day. That's how Democrats defeated the odds in 2022 to defend and even expand our Senate majority. And that's why I know that we can win again in 2024.
With Democrats defending 23 seats, the odds are certainly stacked against us. And after the 2022 red wave in New York, Republicans here are already targeting my seat for defeat. **But when people like you get off the sidelines and chip in even just $5, eventually we'll build a grassroots movement capable of defeating even the GOP's wealthiest megadonors.**

body:
[View in Web Browser](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kE1v4jAQhn-NcyOyx1_JwYddUDigXbWHCuXo2AbcxjjY-Sj99RWUcp15Zt5Hrw5D7w9XheRfBHDyNiMARP8ggEu7hDS9h912JbFrVxfxP_DbFtYPdIYnfDZ6v92tZaunLrvj6-SWuJ_JEx-vg3vCj9DSBe3721RuCqvowWJWOEUkVJIDqevipBjFXNe8w1YywaCTFWamE4ZrLCpi68IrwMAIJkAEF1SWsqr5QULdUWI5oxQxfM8pdXDJG03yuOiUYgyliaHo1Wkch3wXaxA0S4rleTK9m_LPmYkBQfNQRtDMCJq3_NIem4-uS4g299Lo5msRn1MY_sUiKTssvu99FhIxfPx9U8wKvgMAAP__ERxvDA)

If you've been led to believe that peanut butter, almonds and spinach are good for you, today's email might shock you and is important to read, because these 3 healthy foods could be contributing to health problems in your body.

Let's take a quick look at why...

**1\. Peanut butter**

While peanut butter does contain a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in the next food...

**2\. Spinach**

Spinach is promoted as a healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and joint pain.

In fact, some people have even gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

**3\. Almonds**

Although almonds and almond milk are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides, including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

Now let's take a look at a fun little quiz below and a few more foods...

**Bananas vs oranges vs apples... (the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)**
According to the best-selling author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry, there’s one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can **damage your gut and disrupt your hormones**. Both sapping you of energy and **forcing your body to create “sticky” fat cells that can NOT be “burned off” with normal diet and exercise.**

Do you know the fruit I’m talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

Fellow Patriot,

**At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.**

_First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._

And what's worse, they are doing it all because _I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate._

**Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT.

Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end.**

I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=e1b0c10006a54b729dd84d37f42c3109&_e=oGKI7RkzZ6HyeCX6zm0q4In_YCcBEJS687PrEwsICZD_DrHAt9QBB8eZpJph4v3XsellMlTyKfIbtEtYkRSZ-NPeLt5_jKWeui37CpH7n7wNj8jZZV-yqKO3oG25gnJd_Jug4q8XUp5NCMEn9zgJyow9BLqC1b1XjFGjOO26DBb1szqsLSJU8Nqh6OPO9_EcrPuC_91X9qr49Y_9i622HtPf90USOBYPoZa6gXat0tdLkNjZeuLNOeMaSxQrmXIn7sgRYz4hqNjYv1Inq5mSpxIi1qW-dw5eKetssMGO24g6r2HkttiHZEwRz5eBBieS3klLrQoIAfcZDHwx4--TAtdk-YOvDVYgPl4ny6RuizaPg1jwAGgFv7RFaM7_k3svB9pCsHY6WChID0PLqrh1Rk_dkRKGPU_6cKrgh55iMkQ%3D)

clean_body: Please read this full message Fellow Patriot, At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record. And what's worse, they are doing it all because I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate. Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT. Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end. I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. After the Army, I earned a Ph.D. in international relations before moving to Pittsburgh to start a career in business. I worked my way up to become the CEO of FreeMarkets, a successful tech startup that employed hundreds in Western Pennsylvania. I was then called to service again, this time in the highest levels of government as Under Secretary of Treasury and as Deputy National Security Advisor. Following this, I joined Bridgewater Associates, one of the largest, most successful investment firms in the world, which manages the pension plans of groups including teachers, firefighters and law enforcement. I have lived the American Dream, and I am running for Senate to bring my decades of experience and love for our country to fix our broken economy that is a direct result of policies supported by my opponent, who has spent 18 years in Washington with NOTHING to show for it. I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it 's sad to see we've fallen so far that these media outlets like the New York Times and CNN are pushing the Democrats' baked narrative about my upbringing and my business record. I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it! Here's where I need your help, Fellow Patriot. We need to combat these lies with the TRUTH about me. The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. They know if Kamala Harris and Bob Casey lose Pennsylvania, they lose it ALL, and they are going to do WHATEVER IT TAKES to try and defeat me. I hate asking for money -- I'm not a career politician, and it's not in my nature -- but I have no choice but to ask if we're going to hit our fundraising goal for the final stretch of the campaign. | | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, As the election draws closer, the Democrat Party operatives who serve as the masterminds behind their strategy are looking at the polls and sweating. They need to do something and do it fast! What to do? Well, they could call for an arms embargo against Israel until they end the genocide. They could embrace policies wildly popular with the American people like Medicare for All and living wages for all working people. They could take the growing climate catastrophe seriously and demand an end to fracking. Or they could throw a tantrum about Jill Stein and put out an ad that blames her for all their woes. Guess which plan they’re going with?

That’s right, yesterday we made history when the DNC and their handpicked candidate Kamala Harris put out the first ever national ad attacking Jill, once again demonstrating that they’re terrified by the momentum that keeps growing for our people-powered campaign.

They claim that Republicans have been helping Jill. That’s an interesting take when Kamala can’t stop bragging about her endorsements from over 200 Republicans including the architect of the Iraq war, Dick Cheney. Just last week, Kamala was campaigning with Liz Cheney at her side and was breathless in her praise for the warmongering ex-Veep when she thanked him for _“...all he’s done to serve his country.”_ Given she’s running on a promise to preside over _“the most lethal fighting force in the world”_ her praise for Dick Cheney is quite sincere.[**

Peter _, the anti-Democratic Party knows that Jill and Butch are shaking up the status-quo and represent a real challenge to their genocidal empire. We need you to dig deep today, because while they have an endless well of corporate money to put out ads lying about Jill, we rely on the people to get the truth out there to voters everywhere – Stein/Ware is the only choice for every person who sees genocide as a red line. Can you donate today to help us to spread the word to voters everywhere?_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_12_dnc&n=1)

Eight years have passed since Hilary Clinton managed to lose the election to a crude racist and misogynistic game show host. The dirty Dems think they own your vote. Votes are earned, not owned. They’re not just afraid of Jill and Butch – **_they’re afraid of you!_** Your vote is your voice and they’re desperate to silence the millions of people who are sick and tired of the corporate duopoly of war and Wall Street. That’s why they resort to lies and bullying; because they work for their billionaire donors and won’t embrace the policies the people need.

We have the empire on the ropes, let’s get ready to shock the world and deliver a KO in November.

body:

---
| | | America gave him a Purple Heart and I gave him my whole heart.

---
| [](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=3ab3a3e8e8a845d38b438c1274d33299&_e=IC8U8zv5G5VfmZ_cRvP4F8chDYAiLICWNdfbQEFR3dNzCaSBZPROrptCF86IK_Tql_Tu2-IK_U7xOIHBFL3XlqPBa2LKwQeqFhLVG3zsMKRe42jvcSK5yRjcf6bGW6ks7a-hXmQUzLOGxaZfkxpFg5iSCyHL9eFGeHTf5tFTWJXyr7jdveA5RTNnYp0StxVzukyb-DiXX_uLO0IKpYkTCjYu5W8EHbTfT7maI_Mcp8iDIhh9M9hCeNsYOfbjPTXqi4Wc7xyCbezxHBkjvb1u_SweaVhBwWuBdgEruWJ4xqzjynsjFt63rnrwlWgfaRSdyRozVUITckTo2Sa4YF3GL99r7M015e1y7cDs1UR0ZoK7sCGP4qUw6YpTMWwhMQjP9l1-TX-EFSllo7WxOBQoWtznMO5RIe7sh2b_IfJDr3c%3D "Sam Brown")
---

I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban.

He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him.

Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith.

He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan.

And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat.

Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way.

Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation - and for that matter so was I.

He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith.

Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability.

I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior, a hero, a leader.

He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation - and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. It wasn’t enough for Jon Tester to be the #1 recipient of lobbyist contributions in the U.S. Senate. But to say nothing when radical Democrat George Soros funnels more than $10 million into his reelection bid in Montana. That’s outrageous. The corrupt king of Democrat dark money himself, George Soros, is the single most prominent backer of my opponent’s reelection campaign. IF THIS IS NOT REASON ENOUGH TO MAKE A CONTRIBUTION TO HELP ME DEFEAT THIS FRAUD, WHAT IS? Jon Tester is still campaigning as a simple seven-fingered Montana dirt farmer instead of the three-term radical liberal Democrat Senator he is. And George Soros is paying for every tank of gas he uses to crisscross the state and lie to voters about his liberal record. Soros is paying for television ads attacking my valor, family, and business. I’ve told you before that Tester is raising more money from California and New York than Montana voters, using celebrities like Glenn Close and Martin Sheen to solicit donations via email and text. As we near the end of this campaign, things are becoming even clearer: Jon Tester is the candidate of the billionaire and celebrity class, not the working man. Our state deserves principled leadership, and so does our country. Jon Tester has sold out Montana in Washington for long enough. I need your help to fight back against this infusion of Democrat dark money from George Soros and his dangerous allies into our race. to help me secure this seat and retire Two-Faced Tester. Rachel

Derek, Early voting is underway in several states and our final FEC deadline before Election Day is just a few days away, so as the clock runs out, we’re reaching out to ask for your help. But first, we want you to know exactly how we’ll use your $3 donation and every other dollar we raise in these final weeks. Can we count on you to stand with us? Whether it’s $1 or more, your support is critical in this fight. Let’s show the world that we’re ready for change. Let’s show them that we’re ready to **DO SOMETHING**. Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

Hi friend, I’ve had a lot of jobs, but looking back, one stands out as a favorite. Before I ran for Congress, before I served in the Arizona legislature, before I taught at the U of A (Go Cats!), before I worked as an environmental lawyer cleaning up contaminated waste sites and holding corporate polluters accountable — I worked as a National Park Ranger. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94896020/504899245/-1680010047?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20241012_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZThiNzZmNDgtY2U4OC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qxgLockmFh-KBB6V-oeifNyghnYqYw_UqeBrDc1_7ec=) Our national parks are essential sanctuaries for local wildlife and ecosystems. They preserve some of the country's most beautiful places. And they’re the best kind of classroom for learning about conservation in the natural world. Arizona is home to some of the most stunning parks and wild areas, and it’s up to us to protect them for future generations. But protecting our environment goes beyond those public lands. **It means cleaning up pollution in our neighborhoods, protecting our water future, and investing in clean energy that lowers costs and brings good jobs to our state.** With the Supreme Court recently gutting the EPA’s ability to enforce environmental regulations, it’s more important than ever to have voices in Congress fighting for clean air, clean water, and public lands. **That’s exactly what I’ll do. ** **[Team, I’m running in a neck-and-neck race in Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District. Whether it’s $5 or $50, donating now will help my campaign flip this seat blue — so I can fight for our public lands and clean energy future in Congress. clean_body: | = Hi friend, I’ve had a lot of jobs, but looking back, one stands out as a favorite. Before I ran for Congress, before I served in the Arizona legislature, before I taught at the U of A (Go Cats!), before I worked as an environmental lawyer cleaning up contaminated waste sites and holding corporate polluters accountable — I worked as a National Park Ranger. = Our national parks are essential sanctuaries for local wildlife and ecosystems. They preserve some of the country's most beautiful places. And they’re the best kind of classroom for learning about conservation in the natural world. Arizona is home to some of the most stunning parks and wild areas, and it’s up to us to protect them for future generations. But protecting our environment goes beyond those public lands. It means cleaning up pollution in our neighborhoods, protecting our water future, and investing in clean energy that lowers costs and brings good jobs to our state. With the Supreme Court recently gutting the EPA’s ability to enforce environmental regulations, it’s more important than ever to have voices in Congress fighting for clean air, clean water, and public lands. That’s exactly what I’ll do. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through to the Arizona Democratic Party and Kristen Engel immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Thank you so much. name: Rob Mercuri
subject: As Polls Tighten, Speaker Johnson Holds Rally in PA-17
body:
Democrat polling shows this race is within four points.

|
---
Friend, We are just 24 days from Election Day, and that means voters are beginning to line up behind our campaign - how do we know? Because even Democrat polling shows this race within four points! **Speaker Mike Johnson Leads Rally** Doubling down in his support for our campaign, Speaker Mike Johnson held a rally for us yesterday here in PA-17. His presence is a key indicator that our campaign is one of a small number of races that will determine who controls Congress next year. (Picture courtesy of Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.) **The Gap is Tightening in PA-17.** A recent Democrat-sponsored poll shows the gap between us and Chris Deluzio is only four points. [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=X42Olx4n_hRMT5bxl9xfFCQrKWawBPSvw7MhhPjE8b6MQsfwacCF9ihhclQtbIv_CVNFy2wHRzOdMYnFZIoeC0e0r9mhBWQILTlucoM-ajU&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_01_24_email_to_supporters&n=1) This same poll previously had us down by eight points in the summer, which means that we have cut Deluzio’s advantage in HALF with one month to go until November 5th! (Screenshot courtesy of [538](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=3Bj9zXQPSWbh5tOiVGKE2LTfXkOpCa519khLQHQ5fxc&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_01_24_email_to_supporters&n=2).) As voters begin to see the stark choice in front of them, they are saying no to policies that create higher inflation, an open and out-of-control border, and higher gas and grocery prices. | **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Hey Peter, Trump’s back in Arizona tomorrow.
Do you know the exact number of votes that he lost by in 2020? It might surprise you.
**10,457**
It’s not just less than 1% of all votes cast in that election — it’s .3%. The absolute smallest of margins, and the closest presidential election in Arizona’s history.
Trump is coming to Arizona again and again and again because winning here isn’t just critical to his electoral math — it’s personal to him. He can’t believe that he lost last time around and he’s going to do everything he can to make sure it doesn’t happen again.

Ruben is running ahead of Trump in the polls, and what happens in our race is guaranteed to have an impact on whether Trump wins or loses here. Trump knows that if he can bring Ruben down it’s going to help him win.
Trump has attacked Ruben repeatedly in the last two months. We can expect more tomorrow. We have to be ready for him.
