Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your day!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241012-3-900&t=3&akid=2058%2E135344%2EYPcIs8)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

Winning this race is going to be tough. National Republicans are putting everything they have into defeating Bob Casey and flipping PA red. They're spending upwards of $150 million to blanket the airwaves, and there’s plenty more on the way.
Fighting back takes resources, so our biggest FEC deadline yet, we’re asking for your help to ensure that every single voter in Pennsylvania – across all 67 counties – hears Bob’s message.
**To do that, we’ve assigned you Monroe County in Pennsylvania.** Our goal is to raise enough by our FEC deadline to help reach all registered voters in Monroe County which will take just 50 cents a voter.
**Can Bob count on you to step up as a Monroe County sponsor to ensure that we have what it takes to execute our path to victory?**

**Turning that around and winning a battleground race like ours will require getting boots on the ground and talking to every voter across Pennsylvania, and we can’t do that without your help.**

| | | | | **Our warehouse is overloaded with food kits... and YOU WIN!**
With all the worries about food shortages, power outages, and natural disasters, it's no wonder our insanely popular 4Patriots 3-Month Survival Food Kits have sold out over and over again!
So, we asked our warehouse manager, Matt, to make all the 3-Month Survival Food Kits possible.
And holy cow, did he deliver!
However, an enormous batch has arrived at our warehouse, all at once, and now we are swamped with inventory.
Our pain is your gain.
Yup, we're practically bribing you to take 'em off our hands.
When you [**stock up today with this exclusive deal**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18788/6374453/e8fe0f0de06896a7c396b61ed9aeb7ffdc882de1/1ec123a45c2920abf1b9483a8936db74b4e91b67), you'll be helping a family-owned American business save some severe warehousing costs. And we'll gladly pass those savings on to you along with a boatload of FREE GOODIES!
[**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18788/6374453/e8fe0f0de06896a7c396b61ed9aeb7ffdc882de1/1ec123a45c2920abf1b9483a8936db74b4e91b67)

| | | **4Patriots Survival Food Kits are a tremendous value. This is not ordinary food.**
This is delicious, nutritious, good-for-25-years super survival food that helps keep you from going hungry in a crisis. This is high-quality survival food without gross fillers or weird "frankenfood" that the other guys use to pad their survival meals.
They are handpacked right in a family-owned facility in the U.S.A. and you won't believe how inexpensive these kits are.
These Survival Food Kits now contain more delicious food than ever before.
[**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18788/6374453/e8fe0f0de06896a7c396b61ed9aeb7ffdc882de1/1ec123a45c2920abf1b9483a8936db74b4e91b67)
**More Raving Customer Reviews!** ****
**Rory H. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"I was surprised to find that the densely packed packages were easy to prepare and were tasty as well. I definitely recommend having survival food on hand for the times when 'life' happens while we are planning other things." **Billy H. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"Received my food kit, and I was able to make the potato soup on my cookstove. Just needed boiling water. Gave it a good stir and let it simmer. When I opened up the pot, it smelled so good. You can see the chunks of potatoes and carrots in each bite you take. It's a good soup." **Kevin S. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"The 72 hour kit is a perfect starter kit for any scenario. Put one in your car, work bag, in your house or RV. If you want to start preparing safe food, this is where to start." **Carol B. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"I have been iced in this weekend. I thought I would try my potato soup. To my utter delight, IT WAS DELICIOUS. Thank you for such a wonderful product and the peace of mind it brings." **Ken K ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"I am not a full-blown survivalist. I am not an idiot, either. I have been through enough in my life and have seen friends who have been through an emergency situation. Save up if you have to, but get at least a month's supply. It tastes good. Although if it's a dire of an emergency, you will be happy to eat anything. IF you have something to eat for your family. We made some of this product, and had family and friends over for them to taste. They all agreed they didn't think anything would be this good, and they will be ordering. Just do something. You can't miss out on this deal." **Justin A. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"My wife and I tried the food and we were both surprised about how good it tasted and how satisfied it made us feel afterwards. It feels good knowing that I can provide for my family if a crisis arose and I intend to get more in the future. Also the shipping and customer service has been top notch. This is probably the cheapest survival food I have found, and the company is great." **Gary M. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"I actually had lost my job and was homeless for a while. I dug into my food supply, and I cannot fully describe how delicious and easy to prepare everything is. I felt like I was eating like a king. I am going to stock up again as soon as I settle into my new job. Everyone should participate with this company. You will not be disappointed." **John H. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
"We're in Florida and have made many preparations for the aftermath of a possible hurricane. While we are thankful that Florida has not been hit in several years, it gives us great peace of mind to know we have our 4Patriots kit stashed away, knowing it's not a case of "if" but "when"."

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

It saddens me to see that our education system has been taken over by radicals who push insane political ideologies like CRT, DEI, transgenderism and more on our poor children.

To me, it's common sense that school curriculum needs to be focused on the priority of teaching kids basic subjects such as reading, math, and civics.

How did that basic knowledge seem to get conveniently lost over the years?

You and I know that when it comes to a child's education and health, as well as their moral and religious upbringing, parents are primarily responsible.

That's why I believe parents have the right to steer their children's education, especially when it comes to sensitive subjects and that schools should resist the incorporation of non-academic subjects that fall within the family's purview.

And if you agree with me, then I invite you to use the link below to sign the pledge today.

| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0cf99d39db344d43a8feb50a3d139091&_e=p32h3UffgUT4CsVQfdsPr5TCz3khJLCLs7XbksHVst2LhvL13x25W8zO1Kr1s1Q3ptNNnQiF2mirx0_jfGL97X22bAwxFUQQ42ich8wlR-C2kJDM97Z8nfdm693hwbHQ_HcWXG3Ei4eQdNSnVem5awcMPQB3e6PyHqL6kQETcS7QzcQlmHiOvvdfnPCoHHC4rVwJP5ruVJL5-rkFnYIcYjkqAHOkSa7TBHBqoqWFfAWlTy3jmKn4J27A2mE9b3m2dPmBROlP9TlywNaqhJrnIfVI55vb8Yodz7uPNzjT9j40eOIaxBRLPiedR6_D68Ov5UAEa6lvsGb9LR8bFPWHRuZK_7ttwKAcE5F-CzH7c9fae111qtW4T5prDAv5ObvJaPgzRaLatra8dUtRRN5Wyg%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0cf99d39db344d43a8feb50a3d139091&_e=p32h3UffgUT4CsVQfdsPr5TCz3khJLCLs7XbksHVst2LhvL13x25W8zO1Kr1s1Q3ptNNnQiF2mirx0_jfGL97X22bAwxFUQQ42ich8wlR-C2kJDM97Z8nfdm693hwbHQ_HcWXG3Ei4eQdNSnVem5awcMPQB3e6PyHqL6kQETcS7QzcQlmHiOvvdfnPCoHHC4rVwJP5ruVJL5-rkFnYIcYjkqAHOkSa7TBHBqoqWFfAWlTy3jmKn4J27A2mE9b3m2mjzyYqLMZxTZZT2ay6ZDGrI-RTvNsAYbN8aanuWkIJtNL6QP6RI1y00-jMt9sT4fwYWlLiuaVthITi7du8of5gXwgr_SDR_2ADCJAAHSy_AaEL0BUUDeQgS6ysTAYQ269_2LdH3UA0QIx3mPIjADgg%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

If you believe that American children deserve to receive the best education possible, [can I personally ask you to help me accomplish my goal of getting this first-of-its-kind curriculum to anyone who needs it?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0cf99d39db344d43a8feb50a3d139091&_e=p32h3UffgUT4CsVQfdsPr5TCz3khJLCLs7XbksHVst2LhvL13x25W8zO1Kr1s1Q3ptNNnQiF2mirx0_jfGL97X22bAwxFUQQ42ich8wlR-C2kJDM97Z8nfdm693hwbHQ_HcWXG3Ei4eQdNSnVem5awcMPQB3e6PyHqL6kQETcS7QzcQlmHiOvvdfnPCoHHC4rVwJP5ruVJL5-rkFnYIcYjkqAHOkSa7TBHBqoqWFfAWlTy3jmKn4J27A2mE9b3m2vl2fK6bNRhSEAA1syhcsr8XtU3x0tyAruznPYQhkU-QTrclRgjNGttMnMt8KpBX3xbGzewN6HAU1psI1gBQgRCWATEUqKZbeFSsFdsQCxJpU42Z6RGTs7hZxR5Qye4OKVWG1IgUjCEUCB_Ey71TZRw%3D%3D)

If you'd like to help me get Little Patriots to more American children, please click the link below to make your generous tax-deductible gift today:

[**https://secure.americancornerstone.org/little-patriots-tour-donate**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0cf99d39db344d43a8feb50a3d139091&_e=p32h3UffgUT4CsVQfdsPr5TCz3khJLCLs7XbksHVst2LhvL13x25W8zO1Kr1s1Q3ptNNnQiF2mirx0_jfGL97X22bAwxFUQQ42ich8wlR-C2kJDM97Z8nfdm693hwbHQ_HcWXG3Ei4eQdNSnVem5awcMPQB3e6PyHqL6kQETcS7QzcQlmHiOvvdfnPCoHHC4rVwJP5ruVJL5-rkFnYIcYjkqAHOkSa7TBHBqoqWFfAWlTy3jmKn4J27A2mE9b3m2tZs6Oc0tnJ0deP3Ag1jBKiJhLdyH8uV8HXZCREkQA1Hxfg-rKqd3FEm06vR15QRpo1X2K0_UEK8w6_aZ-Tf9OJRo8BVF1x0IZs4UzLD_yAzG6e555ZthjSWqyBsxi6s8uhq_Wx5z3ZNpRG1uNN67cg%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for supporting these efforts--[together we can help kids across the U.S. get the education they deserve.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0cf99d39db344d43a8feb50a3d139091&_e=p32h3UffgUT4CsVQfdsPr5TCz3khJLCLs7XbksHVst2LhvL13x25W8zO1Kr1s1Q3ptNNnQiF2mirx0_jfGL97X22bAwxFUQQ42ich8wlR-C2kJDM97Z8nfdm693hwbHQ_HcWXG3Ei4eQdNSnVem5awcMPQB3e6PyHqL6kQETcS7QzcQlmHiOvvdfnPCoHHC4rVwJP5ruVJL5-rkFnYIcYjkqAHOkSa7TBHBqoqWFfAWlTy3jmKn4J27A2mE9b3m2i_nRuE3ZJ1YZEMgIBq6xvVeABaE1dJgHajxDjj8Da6nifWuaw2UMOqOsiDrKX2IfjO3q191a__lEX4laHajpw6vsR9zLD7eGqlUKiokRDl2UzSZzYun0gBemxOtZoTQwuuBGTrb6WmroyxtDCJ0Ikg%3D%3D)

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

subject: You are one of my most essential supporters. Without your help, I can’t finish out this final month of the campaign.

body:
| Team, I don’t want to alarm you.

I don’t want to stress you out.

But right now, I’m having trouble seeing a path towards our goals. That’s bad, because these goals aren’t arbitrary. They are what we need to raise to win this race.

[So — today, right now, before whatever you have planned later this afternoon, before something else comes up, I’m asking you to split a donation to my campaign and the Voter Protection Project.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81707?t=6&akid=17423%2E878179%2EkegmB2)

We’re moving a ton of resources right now. We’ve rooted through a ton of data to decide where and when we need to push to reach the undecided voters who are going to decide this election. It’s a good plan. It should work.

But if we don’t raise what we need, we can’t run that play. That strategy falls apart.

We can’t let that happen, because this election is going to be far, far closer than the polls let on. There are doors to knock, phone calls to make, ads that need to get on the air in every county of this state, over just about every hour of every day.

[You are one of my most essential supporters. Right now, I need you if we’re going to have any chance at closing this out the right way. Can you chip in? Your split donation with the Voter Protection Project makes a major difference.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81707?t=7&akid=17423%2E878179%2EkegmB2) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Ruben Gallego and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81708?t=8&akid=17423%2E878179%2EkegmB2)

body:
Please share this with as many people as you can. Share with 5-10 people. | | | **Phil Izon’s Newsletter**
---
| [_ _ Donate Today to Continue Our Nationwide Education Efforts _ _](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=670ae2bb612d5d4144078955&u=https%3A%2F%2Frankedchoiceedu.org%2Fcheckout%2Fdonate%3FdonatePageId%3D63be1c6bafeaaa06bd4c3914&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_670ae11f612d5d414407749f&l=en-US&s=XFrVovscCfpT1UjreRuakwqEGeg%3D)
---
**Don’t let the Ads Fool Alaskans, The Dark Money is Funding The Ads To Stop Our Repeal of Ranked Choice Voting, Out Funding Us 100-1.****Our Repeal Has No Impact on Dark Money Funding, it only addressing Open Primary and Ranked Choice Voting**
---
---
|
---
**“So if the ultimate goal of these changes is to pass ranked-choice voting, it behooves us to know where this revolutionary idea came from and who is behind it. Not surprisingly, the supposedly non-partisan idea is funded by far-left donors like Kathryn Murdoch (wife of one of Rupert Murdoch’s sons) and Alex Soros (son of radical billionaire George Soros).”**
---
---
|
---
**Phillip Izon II, whose campaign to repeal the state’s open primary and ranked voice voting system raised only $120,000, said he is still confident that Ballot Measure 2 will prevail on Election Day. He spoke with the Alaska Beacon from Hawaii, where he is taking a monthslong break after signature gathering and fighting the lawsuits that have dogged him since he organized to roll back the state’s new voting system.****“It’s a David and Goliath story,” he said by phone on Tuesday, referring to the biblical tale wherein a young shepherd takes on a Philistine giant and prevails.****He may be outraised by 100-to-1, but Izon said the repeal effort has excitement on its side. He pointed to huge turnouts at events he promoted through radio ads and social media and the signature gathering effort that he said was led by more than 400 volunteers.****The vast majority of the $12 million raised by the pro ranked choice group No on 2 came from out of state. Its top three contributors are nonpartisan advocacy non-profits from the Lower 48: Article IV, in Arlington, Virginia; Unite America, in Denver, Colorado; and Action Now Initiative LLC, in Houston, Texas.****...No on 2 has spent money on radio and TV advertising as well as mailed advertising materials, polling and events. Izon criticized them for focusing on the issue of the open primary rather than mentioning ranked choice voting.****...Izon’s repeal campaign brought in smaller donations that are mostly from Alaskans. He criticized the opposition’s big, out-of-state donors and said he knew from the start that he wouldn’t be able to compete on fundraising.****But Izon said he doesn’t think the pro ranked choice campaign’s ads or its millions will matter in the end.****“I don’t think they’ll be able to spend enough,” he said.**[**Click Here to Read Article**](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=670ae2bb612d5d4144078955&u=https%3A%2F%2Falaskabeacon.com%2Fbriefs%2Falaska-ranked-choice-voting-repeal-effort-outraised-a-hundredfold-campaign-finance-filings-show%2F&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_670ae11f612d5d414407749f&l=en-US&s=A_7wDNzEuMbJpLGBGhV6DxzKvk8%3D)
---
**Though Izon’s focus is ranked choice voting, he said the open primary is worth repealing because it is susceptible to manipulation.****“Anybody can finance a candidate to get on the ballot and get into the top four, and then tell them to drop out,” he said, adding that the idea should scare people from any political party. He pointed to the case of Eric Hafner, the imprisoned out-of-state Democrat who is on the U.S. House ballot after a legal challenge failed. “There’s a sizable chunk of the population that don’t even know Eric Hafner is in prison,” Izon said.****He said there are multiple examples of spoiler candidates in this year’s election, so he would rather political parties vet candidates than deal with that.****“Would you rather vote a straight ticket or have a criminal on your ballot in a general [election]?” he asked. “Personally, I would rather vote a straight ticket.”****The main argument of many opponents of ranked choice voting is that ranking candidates is too confusing for voters. Izon said he thinks that confusion is behind a low turnout in Alaska’s 2022 general election. He said it was his grandfather’s bafflement when confronted with a ranked choice ballot that compelled him to begin the recall in the first place.****...Izon reflected that in fighting one confusing change, he may be precipitating another. But he said he is driven to find the most fair voting system.****“Every time we make a change, we’re hurting someone, and that’s the problem. What is the most fair system right now? I think the most fair system is the system that everyone understands,” he said.**[**Click Here To Read Article**](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=670ae2bb612d5d4144078955&u=https%3A%2F%2Falaskabeacon.com%2F2024%2F10%2F11%2Fwhat-alaska-voters-should-know-as-they-consider-a-repeal-of-open-primaries-and-ranked-choice-voting%2F&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_670ae11f612d5d414407749f&l=en-US&s=j9xqZZSrNzbYDnl3ImTDiZpGC2o%3D)
---
#### **66% OF PUBLIC TESTIMONY WAS IN FAVOR OR REPEAL / REMOVAL OF RANKED CHOICE VOTING OVER 2 DAYS**
---

Not surprisingly, the supposedly non-partisan idea is funded by far-left donors like Kathryn Murdoch (wife of one of Rupert Murdoch’s sons) and Alex Soros (son of radical billionaire George Soros).” | Phillip Izon II, whose campaign to repeal the state’s open primary and ranked voice voting system raised only $120,000, said he is still confident that Ballot Measure 2 will prevail on Election Day. He spoke with the Alaska Beacon from Hawaii, where he is taking a monthslong break after signature gathering and fighting the lawsuits that have dogged him since he organized to roll back the state’s new voting system.“It’s a David and Goliath story,” he said by phone on Tuesday, referring to the biblical tale wherein a young shepherd takes on a Philistine giant and prevails.He may be outraised by 100-to-1, but Izon said the repeal effort has excitement on its side. He pointed to huge turnouts at events he promoted through radio ads and social media and the signature gathering effort that he said was led by more than 400 volunteers.The vast majority of the $12 million raised by the pro ranked choice group No on 2 came from out of state. Its top three contributors are nonpartisan advocacy non-profits from the Lower 48: Article IV, in Arlington, Virginia; Unite America, in Denver, Colorado; and Action Now Initiative LLC, in Houston, Texas....No on 2 has spent money on radio and TV advertising as well as mailed advertising materials, polling and events. Izon criticized them for focusing on the issue of the open primary rather than mentioning ranked choice voting....Izon’s repeal campaign brought in smaller donations that are mostly from Alaskans. He criticized the opposition’s big, out-of-state donors and said he knew from the start that he wouldn’t be able to compete on fundraising.But Izon said he doesn’t think the pro ranked choice campaign’s ads or its millions will matter in the end.“I don’t think they’ll be able to spend enough,” he said. Though Izon’s focus is ranked choice voting, he said the open primary is worth repealing because it is susceptible to manipulation.“Anybody can finance a candidate to get on the ballot and get into the top four, and then tell them to drop out,” he said, adding that the idea should scare people from any political party. He pointed to the case of Eric Hafner, the imprisoned out-of-state Democrat who is on the U.S. House ballot after a legal challenge failed. “There’s a sizable chunk of the population that don’t even know Eric Hafner is in prison,” Izon said.He said there are multiple examples of spoiler candidates in this year’s election, so he would rather political parties vet candidates than deal with that.“Would you rather vote a straight ticket or have a criminal on your ballot in a general [election]?” he asked. “Personally, I would rather vote a straight ticket.”The main argument of many opponents of ranked choice voting is that ranking candidates is too confusing for voters. Izon said he thinks that confusion is behind a low turnout in Alaska’s 2022 general election. He said it was his grandfather’s bafflement when confronted with a ranked choice ballot that compelled him to begin the recall in the first place....Izon reflected that in fighting one confusing change, he may be precipitating another. But he said he is driven to find the most fair voting system.“Every time we make a change, we’re hurting someone, and that’s the problem. What is the most fair system right now? body:
https://www.caraveoforcongress.com/ [https://www.caraveoforcongress.com/] Peter – there are just 24 days left until Election Day, and every second matters if we’re going to win this for Yadira.

This race is a true tossup. Last time, it was decided by only 1,632 votes, and now, Republicans are pouring in incredible amounts of money to make sure we don’t pull off another win.

We need to power up our campaign right now. Before I dive into what we have planned, can you pitch in today to help keep us running strong? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_yc_q4_2024?refcode=email_100924_strategy&amounts=5,25,35,50,75,100,250]

Donate Now → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_yc_q4_2024?refcode=email_100924_strategy&amounts=5,25,35,50,75,100,250]

Here’s what we need to do from now until Election Day to reach as many voters as possible:

Talking to every voter. Meeting folks face-to-face is the best way to share Yadira’s message and make clear why protecting abortion rights and making healthcare more affordable is on the line. We need resources to support our volunteers who are out there every day.

MAHA ISN’T JUST A SLOGAN
We’re Not Just a Little Behind–
We’re Dramatically Worse
Dear Peter,
Ever wonder why America spends more on healthcare than any other country yet has some of the worst health outcomes?
Here’s the answer: **our own government agencies, like the FDA, have been corrupted.**
Unfortunately, many Members of Congress, whom we elect to protect our interests, are taking campaign contributions from Big Pharma, Big Ag, and major food processing companies—the very industries the FDA is supposed to regulate.
I will take this corruption head on!
It’s one of the reasons I’m determined to get President Trump back in the White House and me to Washington so we can reform the FDA from the inside and Make America Healthy Again.
[**I want to put your health ahead of profits, and I need your help to do it.**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-fda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=5)
[Make America Healthy Again](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-fda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=6)
Here’s a breakdown of what’s at stake:
**AMERICA’S HEALTHCARE PERFORMANCE IS DEAD LAST**
When compared to 10 other advanced countries, the U.S. ranks at the very bottom. Our health outcomes lag far behind those of countries like New Zealand, France, and Germany. We’re not just a little behind—we’re dramatically worse.
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-fda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=7)
**WE PAY THE MOST AND GET THE LEAST**
Take a look at healthcare spending vs. outcomes. While the U.S. spends nearly double what other countries do, our performance doesn’t reflect that investment. That’s us, throwing money at a broken system and still falling short.
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-fda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=8)
These charts show a grim reality: **the U.S. has some of the worst health outcomes in the developed world.** Americans are plagued with chronic diseases that are practically unheard of elsewhere.
[**This is not normal, and it doesn’t have to be this way.**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-fda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=9)
If we clean out the corruption in agencies like the FDA, USDA, and CDC, we can cut our healthcare costs in half and double our health outcomes.
**I’m asking for your support** to help me break the cycle of corruption that’s keeping America sick. Help us put President Trump back in the White House this November—and get me inside the FDA to make a real difference.
[Make America Healthy Again](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-fda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=10)
[**The time is short!**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-fda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=11) Visit [Mahanow.org](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fda_10_12_24_all_1&n=12) to contribute to this mission.
Together, we can Make America Healthy Again and restore power to the people instead of corporations.
| |

Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

clean_body: This is not normal, and it doesn’t have to be this way. | | | | | | | MAHA ISN’T JUST A SLOGAN We’re Not Just a Little Behind– We’re Dramatically Worse Dear Peter, Ever wonder why America spends more on healthcare than any other country yet has some of the worst health outcomes? Here’s the answer: our own government agencies, like the FDA, have been corrupted. Unfortunately, many Members of Congress, whom we elect to protect our interests, are taking campaign contributions from Big Pharma, Big Ag, and major food processing companies—the very industries the FDA is supposed to regulate. I will take this corruption head on! It’s one of the reasons I’m determined to get President Trump back in the White House and me to Washington so we can reform the FDA from the inside and Make America Healthy Again. Here’s a breakdown of what’s at stake: AMERICA’S HEALTHCARE PERFORMANCE IS DEAD LAST When compared to 10 other advanced countries, the U.S. ranks at the very bottom. Our health outcomes lag far behind those of countries like New Zealand, France, and Germany. We’re not just a little behind—we’re dramatically worse. WE PAY THE MOST AND GET THE LEAST Take a look at healthcare spending vs. outcomes. While the U.S. spends nearly double what other countries do, our performance doesn’t reflect that investment. That’s us, throwing money at a broken system and still falling short. These charts show a grim reality: the U.S. has some of the worst health outcomes in the developed world. Americans are plagued with chronic diseases that are practically unheard of elsewhere. If we clean out the corruption in agencies like the FDA, USDA, and CDC, we can cut our healthcare costs in half and double our health outcomes. I’m asking for your support to help me break the cycle of corruption that’s keeping America sick. Help us put President Trump back in the White House this November—and get me inside the FDA to make a real difference. Visit to contribute to this mission. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: I was ready to fight on January 6th.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
As a Marine Corps veteran, I never imagined having to use my training to protect myself and my colleagues on the House floor.
#

See this? That's me on January 6:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241012-4-160&refcode2=3339.734936.RmbeXv&t=1&akid=3339%2E734936%2ERmbeXv)
---
As a Marine Corps veteran, I never imagined having to use my training to protect myself and my colleagues on the House floor.
I never imagined teaching my House colleagues how to put on a gas mask and regulate their breathing.
I never imagined I’d be helping frightened colleagues move to safety as insurrectionists started streaming into the Capitol.
I never imagined I’d stay behind after the Capitol security came in to do one more sweep for colleagues who might have frozen and gone to cocoon somewhere hard to find.
I never imagined I would ever have to teach my staff how to knock on the door of our office a certain way to signal it was them and not some attacker — something we did in the Marine Corps when surrounded by insurgents and you didn’t know who was good and who was bad.
And I never imagined I’d have to text members of the House and urge them not to get on buses ready to evacuate us from the Capitol because if we left we’d lose the building to the coup.
Maybe it is the Marine in me, but I will always fight for our democracy. I'd have done it in the Capitol that day — and I will fight as hard as I can to win this race and keep Kari Lake out of the Senate.
Trump’s coming back to Arizona tomorrow. He’s coming back again and again and again because he knows how important this state is. If Trump and the GOP win Arizona they win the presidency and they take control of the Senate. We can't let that happen, and I can't do it without you.
[**Can you please contribute $5 today to my campaign for United States Senate? Everything comes down to Arizona, and I cannot do this without you. Please, Peter.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241012-4-160&t=2&akid=3339%2E734936%2ERmbeXv)

| | **Ballots Mailed Out This Week – It’s Time to Cast Your Vote!** This week is the moment we’ve all been waiting for – **ballots are arriving in mailboxes!** As we head into the final stretch, I want to take a moment to remind you of who I am and why I’m asking for your vote to continue serving Arizona’s 6th Congressional District. I’m not just your congressman – **I’m a dad, an immigrant, and a proud member of our community. My journey is rooted in the American Dream, and I’ve dedicated my time in Congress to making sure that dream is attainable for everyone in our district.**
* As Arizona’s most bipartisan member of Congress, I’ve worked tirelessly to bring real solutions to the table.
* Over the past two years, I’ve delivered tangible results, securing over $60 million in federal funding for local projects like improving our schools, fixing our roads, and upgrading our water infrastructure.
* We’ve supported our law enforcement officers with the resources they need to keep our communities safe, backed our veterans, and safeguarded our seniors.

But this isn’t just about what we’ve done; it’s about continuing the work that needs to be done. **I’m committed to lowering the cost of living, protecting our communities, securing the border, and making the American Dream possible for future generations.** **Cast your ballot on or before November 5th for JUAN CISCOMANI! 🇺🇸** Thank you for your continued support!
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=d64540236c&e=659fba240e)
---
**BALLOTS HAVE DROPPED - VOTE JUAN CISCOMANI**
|
# ***** Debate Recap *****
This week, I joined Clean Elections for a debate against my opponent, Kirsten Engel, and it was clear who is focused on real solutions for #AZ06. While Kirsten gave us more of the same empty rhetoric, I came ready to talk about the issues that matter most to Arizonans. Here are some of the key highlights ⬇️
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=eb6b14e96c&e=659fba240e)
---
2024 Debate - Opening Statement from Juan Ciscomani
|
# **KIRSTEN ENGEL - 2 Minutes of No Solutions**
Two minutes of NO SOLUTIONS on the border from Kirsten Engel, who up until recently DENIED there was an immigration crisis.

Here’s the reality at the border:
* Slow, costly immigration process
* Human trafficking
* Fentanyl deaths
* Rising crime

The border is in CRISIS—we need to tackle this crisis piece by piece as I have fought to do in DC.
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=56d76d6d60&e=659fba240e)
---
Kirsten Engel - No Solutions
|
# **Law Enforcement Has Endorsed Juan Ciscomani For Congress**
**I’ve been proudly endorsed by the National Border Patrol Council and 9 law enforcement agencies because they know my record.** I work every day to secure our border, keep our communities safe, and ensure law enforcement has the resources they need to protect us.

Kirsten Engel? **Not a single endorsement from law enforcement** —because they know they can’t trust her to have their backs.
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=e13cfb5c97&e=659fba240e "Law Enforcement Stands With Ciscomani | Ciscomani for Congress")
---
Law Enforcement Stands With Ciscomani
|
# **Rising Inflation**
I hear the concerns within our community every day – families are struggling with rising costs.

In Congress, I’ve worked to cut the out-of-control spending that’s fueling inflation.

**Kirsten Engel, on the other hand, endorsed this reckless spending** , calling it _"exactly what we need."_
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=ba1f93cfbd&e=659fba240e)
---
Skyrocketing Inflation
|
# **Kirsten Engel's Record in the State Legislature **
Kirsten has been an elected official for 5 years.

What’s she accomplished? **Not much. **

But when given the opportunity to make an impact at the border – **Kirsten Engel voted AGAINST border security. **
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=6f9b9b8002&e=659fba240e)
---
Engel's Record in the State Legislature
|
# **Protect Social Security**
Our seniors deserve protection — **that means safeguarding Medicare and Social Security. **

This isn’t a partisan issue; it’s about protecting those who worked hard and paid into these programs. **I’m committed to ensuring our seniors receive the benefits they’ve earned.**
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=49974f3ce1&e=659fba240e)
---
Protect Social Security
|
# **Vote JUAN CISCOMANI on or before 11/5 - THANK YOU!**
I have been honored to serve #AZ06 for the past two years in Congress, working hard to address the challenges our community faces, especially living on the front lines of the border crisis. **I humbly ask for your vote so I can continue representing our district and bringing real, common-sense solutions to DC. **

**Remember to vote on or before November 5th! 🇺🇸**

## Housing, Builders’ Remedy and Local Control
---
Peter Ohtaki
---
> _Hi Peter-
> We were all talking about the horrible proposal for development on the Sunset Magazine property and we were all pretty clueless - LOL. I said, you know who would know something - Ohtaki. :-) So you were on our minds - hope you are well and what is the deal with that development anyway? :-)_
Yes, the [N17 proposed development](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=670b07a74bf9e73e6599f24e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwillowpark.life&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_67087f454f430740450ded09&l=en-US&s=KkDfIBFS-rKyxinF5pd8e-1kUIk%3D) on the former Sunset magazine HQ is outrageously huge and out of character for Menlo Park - two 460 feet high rises (~40 stories) like in Manhattan plopped into the mid-Peninsula. Over the last decade, the State of California government has taken away local control over zoning to encourage high-density housing everywhere. _**"Builders Remedy” law allows high-density development over objections and zoning of local communities**_ Since some cities have not met their Regional Housing Needs Allocation (RHNA), SB330 Builders Remedy law allows a high-density development with 20% affordable units, in this case high rises, which exceed the city’s zoning height restrictions if the city’s Housing Element hasn’t been approved by the state’s Housing and Community Development (HCD) agency. N17, owned by the son of a Russian oligarch, applied 2 weeks before Menlo Park’s current Housing Element was approved.Unfortunately, there’s nothing cities can do about it, unless we can pressure our state representatives to repeal the Builders Remedy law that encourages these monstrosities! See recent [Daily Post editorial.](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=670b07a74bf9e73e6599f24e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fpadailypost.com%2F2024%2F08%2F26%2Fopinion-the-50-story-elephant-of-menlo-park-politics%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_67087f454f430740450ded09&l=en-US&s=xj5Ci6YIKRgNPBkBIHwSMfP2Vqk%3D)
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=670b07a74bf9e73e6599f24e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D67087f454f430740450ded09%26ss_email_id%3D670b07a74bf9e73e6599f24e%26ss_campaign_name%3DHousing%252C%2BBuilders%25E2%2580%2599%2BRemedy%2Band%2BLocal%2BControl%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-10-12T23%253A35%253A29Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_67087f454f430740450ded09&l=en-US&s=SKwYgUm1PNl2G467tQcJg89w5w4%3D)
---
_**Housing Element and RHNA mandate**_ California requires all cities, towns and counties to zone areas for additional housing in a **Housing Element** every 8 years under the **Regional Housing Needs Allocation (RHNA)**. The state’s Department of Finance estimates population growth statewide, then Housing & Community Development (HCD) requires regional governments, such as the Association of Bay Area Governments (ABAG) to allocate additional housing to each city, town and county. _**Transit-oriented housing makes sense**_ Many cities have increased the density and height of housing near public transit corridors like the Caltrain line on the Peninsula between San Francisco and San Jose. Cities are also converting light industrial warehouse areas built in the 50s and 60s into mixed use areas with office space, housing and retail - called “live-work-play” zones. I was the first Mayor to pass a Housing Element for Menlo Park in over 20 years in 2013. We rezoned 16-acres of empty car dealerships along El Camino Real into mixed use including 680 housing units - mostly apartments walkable to the Caltrain station. I also chaired our General Plan update the rezoned over 500 acres of warehouses into a live-work-play mixed use zone with up to 4500 housing units near Facebook’s headquarters.To give cities more flexibility implementing zoning for housing, I partnered with State Assemblyman Rich Gordon to introduce legislation (AB1690, 2014) which passed with overwhelming bipartisan support in Sacramento and was signed into law by Governor Brown._**California’s top-down approach to housing is an unfunded state mandate**_ No funding is provided by the state for the infrastructure to support the additional housing, such as classrooms, water or transportation, so cities require developers to pay impact fees, which increase the cost of housing. Also, the Sustainable Communities Strategy (SB375, 2008) requires housing to be located near jobs - what’s called the **jobs-housing mix** \- to prevent urban sprawl and reduce GHG emissions from car commuting. However, many employees don’t want to live next to their jobs.The Housing Element is a **top-down unfunded mandate that’s a huge burden on California cities - driven by Dept. of Finance projections for continuing population growth. But people are moving out of California!** So why are we aggravating our residents?And then in 2021, Governor Newsom signed into law Senate Bill 9, authored by State Senator Scott Weiner (San Francisco):_**SB9 took away the primary role of city councils to govern land use to quadruple the density of our neighborhoods**_ SB9 forces increased density in residential neighborhoods, by eliminating single-family zoning to allow each lot, regardless of size, to be subdivided into 4 units. SB9 law took away our local zoning control and allows 4 housing units on your neighbor's lot, resulting in overcrowded classrooms and traffic. High-density housing makes sense on transit corridors and near jobs, not in our neighborhoods. So forget about Transit-Oriented Housing or Jobs-Housing Mix, let’s just densify our charming neighborhoods. Who’s going to fund the additional classrooms, transportation and water infrastructure?_**SB9 will erode the American Dream**_ The goal of buying a single family house in a nice neighborhood is a big draw for immigrants like my grandparents - the American Dream. Some council members believe that single family housing is exclusionary. I beg to differ. We must protect our family-friendly neighborhoods. _**Let’s restore Local Control**_ I encourage concerned Peninsula residents to [**support Lydia Kou**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=670b07a74bf9e73e6599f24e&u=https%3A%2F%2Flydiakou.org%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_67087f454f430740450ded09&l=en-US&s=zNkJH0VXZgHZgJG9p4ygOLaQ-pA%3D), former Palo Alto mayor and Democrat running to challenge State Assemblyman Marc Berman (who voted for SB9) and Menlo Park City Council candidate **Greg Conlon**. Let’s restore local control over zoning and sensible housing that doesn’t change the character of our communities.
---

Peter**,** We are little more than three weeks away from election day. From now until then **we have an incredible opportunity to do everything we can to make history**. Our volunteers have fought hard to earn ballot access. Our first-class candidates for People, Planet, and Peace - Jill and Butch - have been working tirelessly: traveling east, west, north and south for candidate forums, meet and greets, fundraisers, & media interviews. Everywhere they go they have been spreading the message: **America deserves much better than what the parties of War and Wall Street have to offer.** **Now is our time to show what _we_ can do. Are you ready?**
